problem: There are 371 eggs in Margaret's egg collection. If the eggs are organized into groups, each group has 7 eggs. How many groups are there?
75 percent of Andrea's living room floor is covered by a carpet that is 5.3 feet by 7.5 feet. What is the area of her living room floor?

The total number of students in Yoongi's class is 212. Among them, male students account for 1/2 of the total. Among male students, 1/2 of all male students wear glasses. How many male students in Yoongi's class do not wear glasses?

Tickets to the school's dinner theatre cost 2 dollars for children and 3 dollars for adults. 21 tickets were sold, and 10 children attended. What was the total amount of money collected from ticket sales?

A choir splits into 5 groups for their performances. The first group has 18 members, the second group has 29 members, the third group has 34 members, and the fourth group has 23 members. The fifth group has the remaining members of the choir. If the choir overall has 157 members, how many members are in the fifth group?
Benny picked some apples, and Dan picked 9 apples from the apple tree. They picked 62 apples in total. How many apples did Benny pick?

In country Z, 10% of the people do not have a university diploma but have the job of their choice, and 26% of the people who do not have the job of their choice have a university diploma. If 50% of the people have the job of their choice, what percent of the people have a university diploma?
The average weight of 8 persons increases by 2 kg when a new person comes in place of one of them weighing 37 kg. What is the weight of the new person?

If money is invested at r percent interest, compounded annually, the amount of the investment will double in approximately \( \frac{53}{r} \) years. Pat's parents invested $5,000 in a long-term bond that pays 8 percent interest, compounded annually. The approximate total amount of the investment 18 years later, when Pat is ready for college, is $32,900. What is the constant value in the formula to calculate the number of years it takes for the investment to double?
Dawn earns a certain amount each month. Each month, she saves 10% of her salary and saves $5.30. What is her monthly salary?
Joan picked 19 oranges, and Sara picked some oranges. Alyssa picked 30 pears. 72 oranges were picked in total. How many oranges did Sara pick?

Chip has a $40.00 balance on his credit card. Since he didn't pay it off, he was charged a 20% interest fee. He put a certain amount on his credit card the following month and didn't make any payments to his debt. He was hit with another 20% interest fee. The current balance on his credit card is $121.20. How much did he put on his credit card the following month?
Shekar scored 76 in mathematics, 84 in social studies, 62 in English, 65 in biology, and some marks in science. His average marks are 68. What are his marks in science?

It takes a duck 40 days to fly to the south during winter, 2120 days to fly to the north during summer, and 60 days to travel to the East during spring. The duck is flying for 2220 days during these seasons. What is the ratio of the time it takes for the duck to fly to the north during summer compared to the time it takes to fly to the south during winter?
Joan has some books. Tom has 38 books. Together, they have 91 books. How many books does Joan have?
Mei has 15 oranges, 9 peaches, 18 pears, and 11 bananas. How many pieces of fruit does she have in total?
Some ducks are swimming in a lake. Twenty more ducks come to join them, making a total of 73 ducks swimming in the lake. How many ducks were initially swimming in the lake?
Find the divisor when 53^2 is multiplied by 1^3, and then divided by this divisor to get the result 53.

By partial fractions,
$$\frac{53x+2}{x^2-4} = \frac{A}{x-2} + \frac{B}{x+2}.$$Find \(A+B\).
There are five numbers -2, 0, 1, 53, and 54. What is the product of the 3rd largest number and the 2nd largest number?

A car averages some speed for the first 5 hours of a trip and averages 14 miles per hour for the rest of the trip. The average speed for the entire trip is 40 miles per hour. The trip is 7.5 hours long. What was the car's average speed for the first 5 hours?

A shopkeeper bought 212 oranges and some bananas. He found that 25% of oranges and none of the bananas were rotten. The percentage of fruits in good condition is 80%. How many bananas did the shopkeeper buy?
Jessie started to go jogging everyday and lost some weight. She weighed 69 kilograms before beginning jogging and now weighs 16 kilograms. How many kilograms did she lose?

Keaton has a farm with apples and peaches. He can harvest his apples every 3 months and can sell each harvest for $20. He can harvest his peaches every 4 months and can sell each harvest for $36. However, Keaton also has expenses related to fruit harvesting, storage, and transportation. Each apple harvest costs him $15, and each peach harvest costs him $25. How much profit can Keaton earn every year from selling these fruits when taking his expenses into account?

There are 87 walnut trees currently in the park. Park workers will plant some walnut trees today. The park will have 140 walnut trees when the workers are finished. How many walnut trees did the workers plant?

Jack and Jill are friends who borrow from each other often. Last week Jack borrowed some money from Jill, which he promised to pay back with an interest of 10%. He will pay back $58.30. How much did Jack borrow from Jill?

Sara is 14 inches taller than her brother Joe. Joe is 3 inches taller than his friend Roy. Roy is 2 inches taller than his cousin Mark. Mark is 1 inch taller than his sister Julie. If Julie is 33 inches tall, how tall is Sara?
The father is 6 times Taehyung's age, and the mother is 5 times Taehyung's age. If Taehyung is 53 years old, how many years younger is his mother than his father?

The perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 60. If one of the sides of the equilateral triangle is one of the equal sides of an isosceles triangle of perimeter 93, then how long is the base of the isosceles triangle?

There were 20 boys and 25 girls on the playground at recess. Additionally, there were 3 teachers supervising the students. After 15 minutes, 3 boys and 2 girls arrived late to recess. How many people, including students and teachers, were on the playground in total after the late arrivals?

Adam bought 30 packages of cat food and some packages of dog food. Each package of cat food contained 10 cans, and each package of dog food contained 5 cans. Adam bought 35 more cans of cat food than dog food. How many packages of dog food did Adam buy?

Tim decides to cancel his cable subscription and get streaming services. He gets Netflix for $12 a month. Hulu and Disney Plus normally cost $10 a month each but he saves 20% for bundling. How much money does he save by cancelling his $81 cable package?
There are 65 different books and 10 different movies in the 'crazy silly school' series. If you read 12 of the books and watched 56 of the movies, how many more books do you still have to read?

A farmer had planted his fields with corn, sugar cane, and tobacco in the ratio of 25 : 27 : 1, respectively, but he wanted to make more money, so he shifted the ratio to 25 : 26 : 2, respectively. Under the new system, 1 more acre of land was planted with tobacco. How many acres of land does the farmer have in total?
Jane has 28 old, brown sheets of drawing paper and some old, yellow sheets of drawing paper. She has 81 pieces of drawing paper in total. How many old, yellow sheets of drawing paper does she have?
Anne weighs 68 pounds. Douglas weighs some pounds. Anne is 15 pounds heavier than Douglas. How much does Douglas weigh?

A train has some carriages, each of 60 meters length, and an engine also of 60 meters length, running at a speed of 60 km/h. The train takes 6 minutes to cross a bridge 2.76 km long. How many carriages does the train have?
Frank had some money. At the store he spent $45 on a new game. He got another 14 dollars for his allowance. Now, he has 22 dollars. How much money did Frank have initially?
Jake can wash his car with 1 bottle of car wash soap 1 time. If each bottle costs $1.00, and he washes his car once a week for 53 weeks, how much does he spend on car soap?

A feed store sells two varieties of birdseed: Brand A, which is 55% millet, and Brand B, which has a certain percentage of millet and the rest safflower. A customer purchases a mix of the two types of birdseed that is 54% millet. What percent of millet is in Brand B if 50% of the mix is Brand A?

a, b, and c completed a piece of work. a worked for some days, b for 9 days, and c for 4 days. Their daily wages were in the ratio of 3 : 4 : 5. Their total earning was Rs. 4085, and the daily wage of c is Rs. 95. How many days did a work?

A train starts from city A at 8 a.m. and travels towards city B, which is 399 km away. The train travels at 60 km/hr. Another train starts from city B at 9 a.m. and travels towards city A at a certain speed. They meet at 12 p.m. What is the speed of the train starting from city B?
Sara had 21 quarters in her bank. Her dad gave her 32 more quarters. How many quarters does she have now?
How many moles of KCl are formed when 53 moles of KNO₃ react with 53 moles of NaCl to form 53 moles of NaNO₃ along with some moles of KCl, if the moles of KCl are equal to the moles of KNO₃ and NaCl?
A boy goes to school from his house at 3 km/hr and returns home by a different route at 2 km/hr. The distance to school is 60 km, and the return route is 66 km. How long does the whole trip take?
A lady builds a box with 2 cm length, 1 cm width, and a certain height using 106 cubic cm cubes. The minimum number of cubes required to build the box is 106. What is the height of the box?

Nicholas starts with 200 bottle caps. He receives 118 more from Catherine. He gives away 50% of the total to Anthony. Then he keeps 1/3 of the remaining bottle caps and gives the rest away. How many bottle caps does Nicholas have at the end?

A hurricane is approaching the southern coast of Texas, and a rancher is planning to move some head of cattle 30 miles to higher ground to protect them from possible inland flooding that might occur. His animal transport truck holds 1 head of cattle. Traveling at 60 miles per hour, it took him 53 hours to transport all of his cattle to higher ground. How many head of cattle did the rancher have to move?
To build a wall of a certain length, 6 m in height and 11 cm in width, 106,000 bricks, each measuring 5 cm x 11 cm x 6 cm, will be needed. What is the length of the wall?

Suzanna's history textbook has 10 pages and her geography textbook has 2 more pages. Her math textbook has half of the sum of the first two books' pages, and her science textbook has twice the number of pages of her history textbook. If Suzanna stacks all her textbooks on her desk, how many pages would there be in total?
A shop had 80 notebooks. It sold 12 in the morning and 15 in the afternoon. How many notebooks are left?
What is the distance between (0,0) and (0,53)?

A group of hikers plans to go up a mountain and come down using a different route. They will travel down at a rate 53 times the rate they use going up, but the time each route takes is the same. If they go up at 1 mile per day and it takes 1 day, how many miles long is the route down the mountain?
The width of a rectangular hall is ½ of its length. If the area of the hall is 5618 sq. m, what is the difference between its length and breadth?
If xy = 212, x / y = some number, for positive numbers x and y, y = 2. What is the value of x / y?

There is a rectangular prism made of 1-inch cubes that has been covered in tin foil. There are exactly 2601 cubes that are not touching any tin foil on any of their sides. If the width of the figure created by these 2601 cubes is three times the length and seventeen times the height, what is the measure in inches of the width of the foil-covered prism?

There were 7 roses and 12 orchids in the vase. Jessica cut some more roses and orchids from her flower garden. There are now 11 roses and 64 orchids in the vase. How many more orchids than roses are there in the vase now?

For an art show, an artist painted 159 pictures. During the show, he sold some of his pictures, and the ratio of pictures he still has to pictures he sold is 2:1. How many pictures did he sell during the show?
A man invested in Rs. 100 shares of a company at a 47% discount. If his company declares a 5% dividend at the end of the year and he gets Rs. 5, how much did he invest?
By how much is two-fifths of a certain number greater than 12.2? The difference is 9. What is the number?
At the school's book fair, Sam bought 13.0 used adventure books and 17.0 used mystery books. He also bought 23.0 new crime books. How many books did he buy in total?
Some years ago, the ratio of ages of P and Q was 4:3. 4 years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 7:6. P's age at present is 129. How many years ago was the first ratio given?

Nurse Missy is attending to patients. One of them has special dietary requirements, increasing serving time by 20%. It takes 5 minutes to serve each standard patient. It takes Missy 266 minutes to serve dinner to all of her patients. How many patients is Missy attending to?

The average salary of all workers in a workshop is Rs. 60. The average salary of 7 technicians is Rs. 95, and the average salary of the rest is some amount. The total number of workers is 42. What is the average salary of the rest of the workers?

A box measuring 2 inches long by 2 inches wide by 106 inches deep is to be filled entirely with identical cubes. No space is to be left unfilled. What is the smallest number of cubes that can accomplish this objective?
The arithmetic mean of a certain normal distribution is 150. A value is exactly 2 standard deviations less than the mean, which is 44. What is the standard deviation of this distribution?

A and B began business with Rs. 2500 and Rs. 3500. After 8 months, A withdraws Rs. 1250 and B withdraws his entire capital. At the end of the year, their profits are shared in proportion to capital invested. If A's share is Rs. 25, what is the total profit?
A number is doubled and 9 is added. If the resultant is trebled, it becomes 345. What is that number?
Jimin is trying to subtract a number from 65. If the result of mistakenly dividing 96 by a number is 8, find the correct result.

A banana tree had some bananas initially. After Raj cut some bananas from it and ate 70 bananas, he has twice as many remaining in his basket. There were initially 229 bananas on the tree. How many bananas are left on the tree now?

The average age of an adult class is 53 years. 4 new students with an average age of 32 years join the class, therefore decreasing the average by 4 years. The original strength of the class was 17. What was the average age of the class before the new students joined?
A train 350 m long runs with a certain speed. It takes 36 seconds to pass a platform of 180 m long. What is the speed of the train in km/hr?

In traveling from a dormitory to a certain city, a student went \( \frac{1}{5} \) of the way by foot, \( \frac{2}{3} \) of the way by bus, and the remaining \( \frac{106}{15} \) kilometers by car. What is the distance, in kilometers, from the dormitory to the city?

The teacher assigned a minimum of 25 pages of reading for homework. Harrison read 7 more pages than assigned. Pam read some more pages than Harrison and Sam read twice the amount of Pam. Sam read 170 pages. How many more pages did Pam read than Harrison?

Miriam is trying to exercise more and counts her exercises. On Monday she does 4 push-ups. On Tuesday she does 10 push-ups. On Wednesday she does twice as many push-ups as the day before. On Thursday she does half the number of total pushups she already did that week plus 2 more. Finally, on Friday she does as many pushups as the total number she did over the previous four days. How many pushups does Miriam do on Friday?

Matt and Peter can do together a piece of work in 40 days. After they have worked together for 20 days, Matt stops, and Peter completes the remaining work. Peter can complete the work separately in 106 days. In how many days does Peter complete the remaining work after Matt stops?

A trivia team had 60 members total, but during a game some members didn't show up. Each member that did show up scored 5 points. The team scored 35 points total. How many members didn't show up during the game?

Hershel has 10 betta fish and some goldfish in a bowl. His friend Bexley brings him 2 more betta fish and 3 more goldfish. If Hershel gifts his sister 1/2 of the fish, he has 34 fish remaining in the bowl. How many goldfish did Hershel have initially?

Nishita receives an annual dividend from some preferred shares and 3000 common shares, both of par value Rs. 50 each. The dividend paid on preferred shares is 10%, and a semi-annual dividend of 3 ½ % is declared on common shares. Nishita receives a total annual dividend of Rs. 10,765. How many preferred shares does Nishita have?

A Senior Center is hosting a bingo night. $795 in prize money will be given away. The first winner of the night will receive a third of the money. The next ten winners will each receive a tenth of the remaining amount. How many dollars will each of the next ten winners receive?
A train crosses a platform of 47 m in 10 sec. The same train crosses another platform of length 97 m in 15 sec. What is the length of the train?
Hannah fills her kids' stockings with 40 candy canes, 10 beanie babies and 3 books. If she has 1 kid, how many stocking stuffers does she buy total?

Bobby has an aquarium with twice as many fish as Sarah's has. Sarah has 9 more fish in her aquarium than Tony does. Tony has 3 times as many fish in his aquarium as Billy does. Billy has 2 fish. How many fish do all 4 people have put together?

In a test of 30 questions, 53 points are given for each correct answer and 5 points are deducted for each incorrect answer. Maria answered all questions and scored 1010. How many points are given for each correct answer?

Darren bought 5 packs of white t-shirts and 2 packs of blue t-shirts for his basketball team. The white t-shirts come in packs of 7, and the blue t-shirts come in packs of 9. How many t-shirts did Darren buy in all?
The areas of two adjacent faces of a cuboidal box are 53 cm² and 100 cm², and the volume of the box is 530 cm³. What is the area of the third adjacent face?
At the animal shelter, there are 20 puppies and some kittens. Five puppies and eight kittens are adopted. There are 60 animals remaining. How many kittens were there initially?

James joins a football team and becomes the star. He scores 4 touchdowns per game and each touchdown is worth 6 points. There are some games in the season. He also manages to score 2 point conversions 6 times during the season. James beat the old record of 1212 points during the season by 72 points. How many games were there in the season?
Jennifer bought 6 times as many candies as Emily and 12 times as many as Bob. If Emily bought 106 candies, how many candies did Bob buy?
What is the total mass in grams of 1 mole of a compound if its molecular weight is 53 g/mol?

At a people counting station, the number of people counted on the first day was twice the total number counted on the second day. If 159 people were counted on the two days, how many people were counted on the second day?
There are 60 people at a party. 7 leave early. How many people remain?
A fruit seller had 1000 apples. After selling some, he has 470 apples left. What percentage of his apples did he sell?

Mike picked 7 apples, Nancy picked 3 apples and 4 oranges, Keith picked 6 apples and 4 pears, Olivia picked 29 apples and 3 bananas, and Thomas picked 8 apples, 5 cherries, and 2 pears at the farm. How many apples were picked in total?

In a cricket team of 11 members, the captain is 300 years old and the wicket keeper is 3 years younger than the captain. If the ages of these two are excluded, the average age of the remaining players is 7 years. If the average age of the whole team is 60, what is the difference between the average age of the remaining players and the average age of the whole team?
In math class, Taehyung solved 46 problems and kept working on doing 7 more problems. How many math problems did Taehyung solve today?
Rocky had 72 fights in his career and lost 19 of them. How many fights did he win?
Jose played football for 37 minutes and then played basketball for some time. He played for 1.5 hours in total. How many minutes did he play basketball?
Levi wrote each of the vowels on the board 10 times, and also wrote the letter Y 3 times. How many total alphabets were written on the board?
During a commercial break in the Super Bowl, there were four 5-minute commercials and eleven 3-minute commercials. How many minutes was the commercial break?

A furniture dealer has 36 tables. Some tables have 4 legs and some have a different number of legs. She has counted 117 legs in total and found out that there are 16 four-legged tables. How many legs do the other tables have in total?

I travel the first part of my journey at a certain speed and the second part at 60 kmph. I cover the total distance of 279 km to my destination in 5 hours. The first part of my journey lasted 3 hours. What was my speed during the first part of the journey?
Tea worth Rs. 40 per kg and Rs. 50 per kg are mixed with a third variety of tea in the ratio 1 : 1 : 2. The price of the third variety per kg is Rs. 61. What is the price of the mixture per kg?

Sarah walked to school carrying a bag containing some apples. At school, she gave each teacher she saw an apple. She also gave a single apple to each of 5 of her closest friends. And while she walked home, she also ate one of the apples. She had three apples left in the bag when she got home, and she had given away 44 apples to teachers. How many apples did she have in the bag initially?
If taxi fares were $2.00 for the first 1/5 mile and $0.25 for each 1/5 mile thereafter, and the total fare was $15.00, how many 1/5-mile segments was the ride?

If 11 people are at a party and each person shakes hands with every other person exactly once, except that two pairs of people do not shake hands because they already know each other from before, how many handshakes occur in total?

Rachel is 12 years old, and her grandfather is 7 times her age. Her mother is half her grandfather's age, and her father is a certain number of years older than her mother. Rachel's father will be 108 years old when she is 25 years old. How many years older is Rachel's father than her mother?

The dimensions of a multi-purpose hall are 12 feet * 8 feet * 5 feet. The hall needs to be white washed. The cost of white washing the walls is Rs. 0.25 per square feet, and for the ceiling, it's Rs. 0.25 per square feet. The hall has two doors of dimensions 6 feet * 3.5 feet and three windows of dimensions 5 feet * 2.8 feet. Calculate the total cost of white washing the four walls & ceiling of this hall after subtracting the area of the doors and windows.
Roger uses his lunch break to walk the stairs in his office building. He can walk 3,000 steps in 30 minutes. If his daily goal is 5,300 steps, how many minutes will it take him to reach his goal?

In the fifth grade at Parkway Elementary School there are 200 students. 120 students are boys and 100 students are playing soccer. Some percentage of the students that play soccer are boys. There are 33 girl students in Parkway that are not playing soccer. What percentage of the students that play soccer are boys?
One fourth of a solution that was 9% sugar by weight was replaced by a second solution, resulting in a solution that was 20% sugar by weight. The second solution was what percent sugar by weight?

Safety Rent-a-Car rents an intermediate-size car at a daily rate of 22.65 dollars plus 0.20 per mile. City Rentals rent an intermediate-size car for 20.00 dollars plus 0.25 per mile. For what mileage is the cost the same?

Person A can complete a piece of work in 40 days, and person B can complete the same work in some days. If they work together, 93/530 of the work will be completed in 4 days. How many days does it take for person B to complete the work alone?

Tony decided to rent a tiny cottage. The master bedroom and bath totaled 10 sq ft. The 2 guest bedrooms were 5 sq ft each. And the kitchen, guest bath and living area totaled 6.5 sq ft. Tony spends $2 per sq ft of house. How much money does Tony spend on rent per month?

Gopi gives Rs. 84 plus one turban as salary to his servant for one year. The servant leaves after 9 months and receives some amount and the turban. The price of the turban is Rs. 40. How much cash does the servant receive when he leaves?
A pizza parlor offers 7 toppings. A customer can choose any 3-topping pizza, or choose from 18 specialty pizzas on the menu. How many total pizza options are there?
A boat can travel with a speed of 16 km/hr in still water. If the boat takes 3 hours to cover a distance of 207 km downstream, what is the rate of the stream?
If 212 divided by ( 1 + 3 / x ) equals a certain number, and x equals 1, what is that number?
Paul had 74 books. After giving 21 books to a friend, how many books does he have now?
Rs. 318 is shared among John, Jose, and Binoy in the ratio 1:2:3. How much money did John receive?

Woody wants to buy two items: a games console and a new video game. The games console costs $500, while the video game costs $80. Woody already has $50 and receives an allowance of $10 every week. How many weeks will it take him to save the money he needs for both the game console and the video game?
Mingyu's mobile phone charges 1 won per ten seconds for a video call. If Mingyu made a video call with her grandmother for 8 minutes and 50 seconds, how much would it cost?
3 years ago, the sum of the ages of the mother and son was 259, and this year, when the mother is 4 times the age of the son, how old is the son this year?
Alex has 765 meters of silk. Each dress needs 5 meters of silk. He makes 100 dresses and gives the rest of the silk equally to his 5 friends. How many meters of silk does each friend get?
A bag is marked at a certain price and is sold for $42.40 with a 20% discount. What was the original price of the bag?
Alyssa picked 36 pears and Nancy picked 17 pears from the pear tree. How many pears were picked in all?

Mary had 7 nickels in her bank. Her dad gave her 11 more nickels, and her mom gave her 3 times the amount her dad gave. After receiving an additional 2 nickels for doing chores, how many nickels does Mary have now?
There are some red peaches and 52 green peaches in the basket. There is 1 more red peach than green peaches in the basket. How many red peaches are in the basket?
In Smithtown, the ratio of men to women is 1 to 3. If 25% of all people are left-handed women, and all men are right-handed, how many right-handed men are there if the total population is 212?
If the cost price of 153 chocolates is equal to the selling price of 100 chocolates, what is the gain percent?
At a restaurant each adult meal costs $3 and kids eat free. A group of some people came in and 38 were kids. It cost $45 for the group to eat. How many people were in the group?

Andy walks 70 meters from his house to school. After school, he goes to the park which is 40 meters away from the school. From there, he goes back to the house, covering a distance of 57 meters. Finally, he goes to the market. If he walks 220 meters in total, how many meters is the distance between the house and the market?
There are 212 passengers on the bus. Half of the passengers are women and the rest are men. If half of the men are standing, how many men are seated?
Set J consists of 54 consecutive integers. If the 5th smallest term in the set is 5, what is the range of the positive integers in set J?
The LCM of two numbers is 40810 and their HCF is 1. If one number is 770, what is the other number?

Sara sent letters to her friend in China every month. She sent 6 letters in January, 9 letters in February, and in March she sent some number of letters. Sara sent 333 letters in those three months. What is the ratio of the number of letters Sara sent in March to the number she sent in January?
On dividing 107 by a number, the quotient is 2 and the remainder is 1. What is the divisor?
John buys 2 dress shirts. They sell for $25 each. He also has to pay 6% tax on everything. How much did he pay in total?
The ratio of pens to pencils is 5 to 53. There are 48 more pencils than pens. How many pencils are there?
The Silvergrove Public Library used a grant to purchase 247 books. Now the library has a total of 300 books. How many books did the library have before the grant?

It will take 106 days for Cameron to complete a certain task alone. He worked for 53 days before he was joined by Sandra. Both of them completed the remaining task in 26 and a half days. How many days will it take both of them to complete the entire job?
60 minus (35 divided by 5) equals what number?
I have 424 cents to buy candy. If each piece of bulk candy costs 8 cents, I can buy _____ gumdrops.
If 2.5 of a certain item costs a certain amount, and 3.5 of the same item costs 74.2 dollars, how much does 2.5 of the item cost?
Ashok and Pyarelal invested money together in a business and share a capital of Ashok is 1/53 of that of Pyarelal. They incurred a loss of Rs 54. What is the loss of Pyarelal?

In a class of 100 students, students were asked if they like French fries, burgers, or neither. 40 students said they like French fries and 30 said they like burgers, with these statistics including the responses of 23 students who said they like both French fries and burgers. How many students do not like either food?
David obtained 72 marks in English, 60 in Mathematics, some marks in Physics, 62 in Chemistry and 84 in Biology. His average marks are 66.2. What marks did he obtain in Physics?
Mike went to 15 basketball games this year, but missed 41. He went to 38 games last year. How many basketball games did Mike go to in total?
What is the length of a bridge (in meters), which a train 447 meters long and travelling at 45 km/h can cross in 40 seconds?
What is the area of a rectangle with a perimeter of 108 centimeters (cm) and a length of 53 centimeters (cm) in square centimeters (cm2)?

Eugene built a complex model house out of toothpicks and a deck of playing cards. For every card, he used 64 toothpicks for the walls and an additional 12 toothpicks for each of the windows and doors. The deck of playing cards had 52 cards, and Eugene used all but 23 of the cards to build his house. There are three windows and two doors on each card-built structure. If he further constructed a roof using 36,154 toothpicks, and a box of toothpicks contains 750 toothpicks, how many boxes of toothpicks did Eugene use to create his model house?
A man walking at a certain speed crosses a bridge in 15 minutes. The length of the bridge is 13,250 meters. What is the man's speed in km/hr?
The youngest of 4 children has siblings who are 3, 6, and 7 years older than she is. If the average (arithmetic mean) age of the 4 siblings is 57, what is the age of the youngest sibling?

John would use 12 large planks of wood and 10 small planks for the walls of the house. If large planks together need a certain number of nails to be secured and small planks together need 5 nails, John needs 58 nails for the house wall. How many nails do the large planks need together?

A cheese factory sells its cheese in rectangular blocks. A normal block has a volume of \(6 \frac{5}{8}\) cubic feet. If a large block has twice the width, twice the depth, and twice the length of a normal block, what is the volume of cheese in a large block in cubic feet?

Vanessa has decided to sell some of her clothes to make pocket money, offering a standard price for each type of item. She made a total of $391 by selling 7 dresses and 4 shirts. If she managed to sell each shirt for $5, how much did the dresses sell for each?

The average mark of the students in a class in a particular exam is 85. If 5 students whose average mark in that exam is 37 are excluded, the average mark of the remaining will be 90. Find the number of students who wrote the exam.
The average weight of 8 persons increases by 3 kg when a new person comes in place of one of them weighing 29 kg. What might be the weight of the new person?
Wilson has a number in mind. If he takes away one-third of the number from it, the result is one hundred six-thirds. What is the number Wilson has in mind?
37 red peaches, 90 yellow peaches and 16 green peaches are in the basket. How many red and green peaches are in the basket?
The average weight of some students is 56 kg. By the admission of a new student, the average weight is reduced to 55 kg. The weight of the new student is 2 kg. How many students were there initially?
Terry cut a rope into two pieces. The shorter piece is 18 inches and the longer piece is 35 inches. What is the total length of the rope?
A grocery store had a total of 62 bottles of which 9 were bottles of regular soda and the rest were bottles of diet soda. They also had 29 apples. How many bottles of diet soda did they have?
Tom purchased 8 kg of apples at the rate of 6 per kg and 1 kg of mangoes at the rate of 5 per kg. How much amount did he pay to the shopkeeper?
At a football banquet, 27 guests attended. Each guest ate exactly 2 pounds of food, except one guest who ate only 1 pound. How many total pounds of food were consumed at the banquet?
50% of x is greater than 1/3 of x by 53/6. What is x?

Jeff wanted to rent an apartment for the next 5 years until he finishes his studies. He found a nice apartment next to his school, and he agreed to pay $300 each month. For some time everything went fine, but then the owner wanted to raise the price to $350 per month. Jeff agreed again and continued paying until he graduated. He ended up paying $18,350 for the apartment throughout the 5 years. How many months did Jeff pay $300 per month before the price increase?

Christian’s father and the senior ranger gathered firewood as they walked towards the lake in the park and brought with them sacks. If every sack can contain around 25 pieces of wood, they filled 2 sacks completely and then found 3 more loose pieces on the ground. How many pieces of wood did they gather in total?

Because of the decision Sofia asked the students to suggest specific types of food. If 228 students suggested adding mashed potatoes, 76 suggested adding bacon to the menu, and 23 suggested adding tomatoes. How many more students suggested bacon than those that suggested tomatoes?
Tom found 56 seashells on the beach. He gave Jessica some of the seashells and now has 3 seashells. How many seashells did Tom give to Jessica?
John starts a TV show. The first episode costs $20 to produce. The second episode costs $33. How much did the two episodes cost in total?

Cindy and Olaf made some candied apples which they will be selling for $2 each, and 12 candied grapes which they will be selling for $1.5. They will earn $124 if they sell everything. How many candied apples did they make?

Mary has a mystery book library. She started with 60 mystery books at the beginning of the year. She joined a book club that sent her 1 book each month of the year. She went to a bookstore halfway through the year and bought 3 more books, then bought 1 book at a yard sale later. Her daughter gave her 2 books for her birthday, and her mother gave her a series of 3 books when Mary visited her. She donated 20 books she didn't want to read again to a charity shop and sold 8 to a used book store. How many books did she have at the end of the year?

Robi and Rudy contributed money to start a business that could earn them profit. Robi contributed $106, and Rudy contributed 4 times as much money as Robi. If they made a profit of 20 percent of the total amount and decided to share the profits equally, calculate the amount of money each got.

Sand is poured into a box so that the box is being filled at the rate of 3 cubic feet per hour. The empty rectangular box is 5.3 feet long, 5 feet wide, and 6 feet deep. Approximately how many hours does it take to fill the box?
A cookfire burns seven logs every hour. It was built with sixty-eight logs to start. If it gets four more logs added to it at the end of every hour, how many logs will be left after 5 hours?
A man fell into a 58-meter deep well. In one day, he climbs 6 meters up and slips 5 meters down. How many days would it take for him to come out of the well?

Ajay bought 20 kg of dal at the rate of Rs 30 per kg and 10 kg at a certain rate per kg. He mixed the two and sold the mixture at the rate of Rs 50 per kg. His total gain in this transaction was Rs 370. What was the rate per kg of the 10 kg dal he bought?
The diagonals of a rhombus are 20 cm and another length. The area of the rhombus is 530 cm². What is the length of the other diagonal?
A number consists of 2 digits whose sum is 8. The number is 18 more than the number formed by reversing its digits. Find the number.

Chris, tasked to lead the newspaper collection, was able to obtain 12 newspapers from their neighborhood. His sister Lily helped him and was able to get some newspapers from another block. They were able to collect 65 newspapers together. How many newspapers did Lily collect from the other block?

Edward bought 79 tickets at the state fair. He spent some tickets at the 'dunk a clown' booth and decided to use the rest on rides. If each ride cost 2 tickets, he could have gone on 13 rides. How many tickets did Edward spend at the 'dunk a clown' booth?

Romeo buys 20 bars of chocolate, each with different prices ranging from $7 to $10. He sells these chocolates for a total of $308. The packaging material for each bar of chocolate has different costs ranging from $2 to $4. Furthermore, Romeo spends $20 on advertising. How much profit does he make for all the chocolates he sells, assuming he spends a total of $175 on purchasing the chocolate bars and $60 on their packaging costs?
A number plus x equals 100, and x is 47. What is the number?
Benny picked 2 apples and Dan picked 55 apples from the apple tree. Dan picked _____ more apples than Benny.

In a shopping mall, one T-shirt costs $15 each; a pair of pants costs $60; a pair of shoes costs a certain amount. All items will get a 10% discount. Eugene has to pay $311.40 if he buys four T-shirts, three pairs of pants, and two pairs of shoes. How much does one pair of shoes cost?

The last place that he went to was the city animal shelter. There he donated some money to make sure the dogs and cats there are being taken care of. If there are 645 cats and 592 dogs there, how many more cats are there than dogs?

Let x be the initial number of pens you have, y be the number of pens Mike gives you, and z be the number of pens you give to Sharon. 

Initially, you have x=5 pens. 

Mike gives you y=30 pens.

Cindy doubles your pens, so you now have 2(x+y) pens.

You give Sharon z=17 pens.

The final number of pens you have is then 2(x+y)-z.

Now, substitute the values for x, y, and z and solve the equation: 2(5+30)-17.

At an auction event, the price of a TV, whose cost was $40, increased by 50%. The price of a phone, which was $30, increased by 20%. A laptop with an initial price of $50 decreased by 10% during the auction. Additionally, Bethany paid a fixed auction fee of $88. Calculate the total amount Bethany received for the items after the sale, considering the percentage changes and the fee.

Marcell and Beatrice are having a contest to see who can eat the most fruit roll-ups, so they unroll as many as they can find. Unfortunately, someone makes a mistake and Beatrice's was two roll-ups wide and 26 rolls up long while Marcell's was 3 roll-ups wide and 18 roll-ups long. If they both ate their entire amount, how many did they eat on average?
Wendy is three times as old as Colin will be 47 years from now. In 7 years, Colin will be one-fifth as old as Wendy is now. How old is Colin now?
An ice cream cone has radius 106 inches and height 53 inches. What is the number of inches in the radius of a sphere of ice cream which has the same volume as the cone?
A reduction of 25% in the price of oil enables a housewife to obtain 5 kg more for Rs 1060. What is the reduced price per kg?
Donald went to a computer store. He saw a 15% reduction in the price of the laptop he wants to buy. If he will pay $45.05 for the laptop, what was the original cost of the laptop?

An equilateral triangle T2 is formed by joining the midpoints of the sides of another equilateral triangle T1. A third equilateral triangle T3 is formed by joining the mid-points of T2 and this process is continued indefinitely. The sum of the perimeters of all the triangles is 318 cm. What is the length of each side of T1?

Beau’s sons are triplets. They are 62 years old today. Some years ago, the sum of his 3 sons’ ages equaled Beau’s age. Beau is 80 years old today. How many years ago did the sum of his sons' ages equal Beau's age?

A train of length l is traveling at a constant velocity and passes a pole in t seconds. If the same train travelling at the same velocity passes a platform in some time, then the length of the platform is 52l. What is the ratio of the time taken to pass the platform to the time taken to pass the pole?
Josh wants to build a square sandbox for his son. He can buy sand in 1 sq ft bags for $4.00 a bag. It will cost him $11,236 to fill the sandbox. What is the length and width of the sandbox?
A woman can do a piece of work in some days. A man is 25% more efficient than the woman. A man can do the same piece of work in 42.4 days. In how many days can the woman do the same piece of work?

Sasha heard that planting trees helps to reduce the local temperature. For each tree planted, the temperature drops .1 degree. A tree costs $1 to plant. If she got the local temperature to drop from 80 to 74.7, how much did it cost to plant the trees?

A patient is given exactly 200 milliliters of a mixture of two medications daily. Medication A contains 40% pain killer and medication B contains 20% pain killer. If the patient receives exactly 69.4 milliliters of pain killer daily, how many milliliters of medication B are in the mixture?

He went to see the oranges being harvested. He found out that they harvest 66 sacks per day and that each sack contains a certain number of oranges. After 87 days of harvest, they will have 304326 oranges. How many oranges are in each sack?

Kristine has 4 more CDs than Dawn, and Dawn has 5 CDs. Mark has twice the number of CDs as Kristine. Alice has 6 CDs less than the total number of CDs Kristine and Mark have combined. How many CDs do they have together?

Taegan goes to a carnival where she wins tickets from some carnival games and also finds 5 tickets on the floor. Each ticket is worth $3. In total, she has tickets that total a value of $333. If Taegan won an equal number of tickets from each of the games, and she won 2 tickets per game, how many games did she play?
Cat Cafe Meow has 23 more cats than Cat Cafe Paw. Cat Cafe Paw has 3 times as many cats as Cat Cafe Cool. If Cat Cafe Cool has 5 cats, how many cats are there in Cat Cafe Meow and Cat Cafe Paw?
If the arithmetic mean of p and q is 15 and the arithmetic mean of q and r is 41.5, what is the value of r - p?
n is the greatest number which divides 900004, 1800003, and 2700002 and gives the same remainder in each case. What is the sum of the digits in n?
If 1431(P's capital) = 1060(Q's capital) = 540(R's capital), then out of the total profit of Rs 100, how much will R receive?

A thief goes away with a Santro car at a speed of 105 km/h. The theft is discovered after half an hour and the owner sets off in a bike at 106 km/h. When will the owner overtake the thief from the start?

The average weight of 8 persons increases by 6 kg when a new person comes in place of one of them weighing a certain weight. The weight of the new person is 101 kg. What was the weight of the person who was replaced?

Fran's school just instituted a school uniform policy. Each student needs to buy five complete uniforms, each consisting of pants, shirt, tie and socks. The pants cost $20, the shirt costs a certain ratio as the pants, the tie costs 1/5 as much as the shirt and the socks cost $3/pair. Each student needs to spend $6475. What is the ratio of the cost of the shirt to the cost of the pants?
Joan has some books. Tom has 38 books. They have 91 books together. How many books does Joan have?
A train running at a certain speed crosses a pole in 18 seconds. The length of the train is 265 meters. What is the speed of the train in km/hr?

Janette went camping for 1 day. She brought along 76 pieces of beef jerky. She wants to ration it out so that she can eat a certain number of pieces for breakfast, 1 for lunch, and 2 for dinner each day. When she returns from the trip, she plans on giving half of the remaining pieces to her brother. She will have 10 pieces of beef jerky left once she does this. How many pieces of beef jerky did she eat for breakfast each day?
The sides of a rectangular field are in the ratio 1 : 53. If the cost of fencing the field at 25 paise per meter is 27 rupees, what is the area of the field in square meters?

Avery opens a flower shop. She ties 4 bunches of flowers with a certain number of flowers in each bunch. If she put 106 flowers in each bunch instead, she would have 2 bunches. How many flowers were in each bunch initially?

In a large multicultural city, there are 1000 people. Among them, 400 are not working, 300 have families, 700 are known to sing in the shower, and 53 engage in sports every weekend. Furthermore, it is known that some of these people are senior citizens, predominantly not working but fond of singing in the shower. What is the largest possible number of people in the city who are working, don't have families, enjoy singing in the shower, partake in sports, and are not senior citizens?

A baker sells pastries for $5 and works 7 days a week. On Monday he sold a certain number of pastries. Every day the number of sales increases by 1 compared to the previous day. On average, he sells 56 pastries each day of the week. How many pastries did he sell on Monday?
A number is doubled and 9 is added. If the resultant is trebled, it becomes 345. What is that number?
The speed of a car is 50 km in the first hour and 56 km in the second hour. What is the average speed of the car?
The number of diagonals of a polygon of n sides is given by the formula q = n ( n - 3 ) / 2. If a polygon has 1325 diagonals, how many sides does it have?
A student was asked to find \( \frac{4}{5} \) of a number. But the student divided the number by \( \frac{4}{5} \), thus the student got \( 23.85 \) more than the correct answer. What is the number?

A salesman's terms were changed from a flat commission of 5% on all his sales to a fixed salary of Rs. 453 plus 2.5% commission on all sales exceeding Rs. 4,000. His sales were worth Rs. 12,000. How much more was his remuneration in the new scheme compared to the previous scheme?
The difference between the compound interest compounded annually and simple interest for 2 years at 20% per annum is Rs. 2.12. Find the principal amount?
Linda spent 50/53 of her savings on furniture and the rest on a TV. If the TV cost her $3, what were her original savings?

Liz's basketball team is down by 118 points in the final quarter of their game. Liz goes on a shooting spree, sinking 5 free throw shots, 3 three-pointers, and some other jump shots. The other team only scores 10 points that quarter, and none of Liz's teammates manage to score any points. Liz's team loses by 8 points at the end of the game. How many other jump shots did Liz sink?
Anna puts three slices of ham in each sandwich. If she has 37 slices of ham, how many more slices of ham does she need to make 30 ham sandwiches?

A local restaurant recently renovated its dining space, purchasing new tables and chairs to use in addition to the original tables and chairs. The new tables each seat 6 customers, while the original tables each seat 4 customers. Altogether, the restaurant now has 73 tables and is capable of seating 418 customers. How many more new tables than original tables does the restaurant have?
Pinky made 147 miniature pumpkin pies for everyone and Helen made some. They have in total 200 miniature pies. How many miniature pies did Helen make?

Cole drove from home to work at an average speed of 106 km/h. He then returned home at a certain average speed. The round trip took a total of 6 hours, and it took Cole 120 minutes to drive to work. What was his average speed driving back home?
Ofelia saved $80 in January and $27 in February. How much more did she save in January than in February?

Austin and Jake start descending from a certain floor of a building at the same time. Austin uses the elevator and Jake uses the stairs, descending 3 steps every second. The stairs have 30 steps across each floor. The elevator will take 500 seconds to get to ground level, and Jake will get to the ground floor 30 seconds later. From which floor did they start descending?

A, B and C rent a pasture. A puts 10 oxen for 53 months, B puts 12 oxen for 5 months and C puts 1 ox for 53 months for grazing and the rent of the pasture is Rs. 643. C should pay Rs. 53 as his share of rent. For how many months did A put his oxen for grazing?

A classroom has a whiteboard shared between 4 teachers. Each teacher has 4 lessons per day and uses the whiteboard in each lesson. If the whiteboard is cleaned 3 times per lesson, and additionally it is cleaned 5 times during the day (morning, between periods, and after school), how many times is the whiteboard cleaned in a day?
In what time will a railway train 530 m long moving at the rate of 36 kmph pass a telegraph post on its way?

Shannon makes herself iced coffee by brewing hot coffee and adding ice cubes. Each ice cube cools the coffee by 10 degrees but makes the coffee 8 milliliters weaker. Any added liquid also weakens the coffee. How many milliliters weaker is Shannon’s iced coffee when it is cooled by 50 degrees and she adds 13 milliliters of cream?

Holden's current master bedroom is 406 sq ft and his master bath is some sq ft. He wants to add a home office/personal gym divided space that is twice as large as his bedroom and bathroom. The new room will have 918 sq ft. How large is Holden's master bath?
A train running at a certain speed crosses a pole in 18 seconds. The length of the train is 265 meters. What is the speed of the train in km/hr?
If Ann is 25 years old and her brother is twice her age, how old will her brother be in 3 years?
A cricket bat is sold for $318, making a profit of 20%. What is the profit amount?
318 raspberries, blackberries, and blueberries were picked in total. Half of all the berries were raspberries, and a third of the berries were blackberries. How many of them were blueberries?
Rachel took some money from her piggy bank. Now she has three dollars in her piggy bank. Originally, there was $56 in her piggy bank. How much money did Rachel take from her piggy bank?

A tourist purchased a total of 17 traveler’s checks in $1 and $5 denominations. The total worth of the traveler’s checks is 53 dollars. He can spend 5 checks of the $1 denomination so that the average amount (arithmetic mean) of the remaining traveler’s checks is $4. What is the total worth of the traveler’s checks?

Suraj has a certain average of runs for 9 innings. In the next innings, he scores a certain number of runs, thereby increasing his average by 5 runs. His average after this innings is 8. How many runs did he score in the next innings?
The P.T.O. bought 5 shirts at $8 each and 1 shirt at $13 for the field day. How much did they spend in total?
Eunji is doing gymnastics standing in the 20th position from the right and the 34th position from the left in a single line. How many students are in the line?
A company invited some people to a luncheon, but 5 of them didn't show up. If the tables they had held 8 people each and they needed 6 tables, how many people were initially invited to the luncheon?

Sebastian bought art exhibit tickets for his parents and himself. Tickets were $12 per person. He was also charged a $17 service fee for the online transaction. What is the total amount he paid for the tickets?

Marcel goes to the store with Dale to buy groceries for cooking dinner. Marcel buys 10 ears of corn, and Dale buys half that amount. Dale buys some potatoes and Marcel buys 4 potatoes. They check out together and end up buying 72 vegetables. How many potatoes did Dale buy?

When all her clothes are washed and in her closet, Brie has 100 blouses, 10 skirts, and 8 slacks. Today in her hamper, she has 53% of her blouses, 50% of her skirts, and 25% of her slacks. She needs to put 60 pieces of clothing in the washer. What percentage of her blouses are in the hamper?
Let \(m\) and \(n\) satisfy \(mn=54\) and \(m+n=55\). What is \(|m-n|\)?
Suppose that \( f(x) \) is a function such that for every real number \( x \), (i) \( f(x) + f(1 - x) = 60 \) and (ii) \( f(1 + x) = 7 + f(x) \). Then \( f(x) + f(-x) \) must equal?
Cindy's mom baked 30 cookies. Paul's dad baked 23 cookies. They both brought them to school for a party. How many cookies did they have altogether?
The sum of ages of 5 children born at the intervals of 3 years each is 295 years. What is the age of the youngest child?
Robin's class is going on a field trip to the zoo. Each van can hold 11 people, and there are some students and 2 adults going. They will need 5 vans. How many students are going on the field trip?

The school is planning a field trip. The school has 67 classrooms. There are a certain number of students in each classroom. If there are 53 seats on each school bus and 67 buses are needed to take the trip, how many students are in each classroom?
A local kennel has cats and dogs in the ratio of 50 : 53. If there are 3 fewer cats than dogs, how many dogs are in the kennel?
Mrs. Wong had 61 Valentines. She gave 8 Valentines to her children. She is left with _____ Valentines.
A bus trip of 2862 miles would have taken 1 hour less if the average speed for the trip had been greater by 1 mile per hour. What was the average speed, in miles per hour, for the trip?

A man starts walking at 3 pm. He walks at a speed of 4 km/hr on level ground for the first hour, then his speed increases to 5 km/hr on level ground for the next 30 minutes. After that, he walks uphill at a speed of 3 km/hr for 45 minutes, and his speed reduces to 2 km/hr for the following 30 minutes uphill. Next, he walks downhill at a speed of 6 km/hr for 30 minutes and then at a speed of 7 km/hr downhill for another 15 minutes. Lastly, he walks on level ground at a speed of 5 km/hr for 30 minutes, then at 20 km/hr for 1.5 hours, and finally at 8 km/hr for the last 45 minutes to reach home at 9 pm. Calculate the distance covered on one way during this journey.
Cindy's mom baked some cookies, and Paul's dad baked 100 cookies. They both brought them to school for a party, and they had 153 cookies altogether. How many cookies did Cindy's mom bake?

Gloria wants to buy the $129,000 mountain cabin that her friend Alfonso is selling. She has some cash and intends to raise the remaining amount by selling her mature trees for lumber. She has 20 cypress trees, 599 pine trees, and 24 maple trees. She will get $100 for each cypress tree, $300 for a maple tree, and $200 per pine tree. After paying Alfonso for the cabin, Gloria has $53 left. How much cash did Gloria initially have?
Roger had 74 dollars. He spent some money on a new game and with the money he had left, he could buy 3 seven-dollar toys. How much did the new game cost?

The tallest building in the world is 30 feet tall. The second tallest is half that tall, the third tallest is two-fifths as tall as the second, and the fourth is one-third as tall as the third. How tall are all 4 buildings put together?
The difference between the square of a number and the square of 48 is 505. What is the number?
If 1 honey bee makes 1 gram of honey in 20 days, how many grams of honey do 53 honey bees make in 20 days?
What must be added to each term of the ratio 7 : 27, so as to make it equal to 3 : 4?

The average (arithmetic mean) of 16 students' first quiz scores in a difficult English class is 60.5. When one student dropped the class, the average of the remaining scores increased to 61.0. What is the quiz score of the student who dropped the class?
A number is doubled and 9 is added. If the resultant is trebled, it becomes 345. What is the original number?
There are 265 books in a library. On Monday, some books are taken out. On Tuesday, 22 books are brought back. There are now 234 books in the library. How many books were taken out on Monday?

In a certain school, 18 students are below 8 years of age. The number of students above 8 years of age is 2/3 of the number of students of 8 years of age, which is 21. What is the total number of students in the school?
The sum of the first 53 odd numbers is 53 times a certain number. What is that number?

Milly is making croissants. She needs to fold the dough 3 times, which takes 4 minutes each time, then let it rest for a certain number of minutes each time. Mixing the ingredients takes 8 minutes and baking the croissants takes 25 minutes. The whole process takes 3 hours and 24 minutes. How many minutes does the dough need to rest each time?

There were a total of 1007 football games in the season. The season is played for some months. Each month had 19 football games, assuming the same number of games were played each month. How many months did the season last?

In a certain alphabet, 5 letters contain a dot and a straight line. 2 letters contain a straight line but do not contain a dot. The alphabet has 60 letters, all of which contain either a dot or a straight line or both. How many letters contain a dot but do not contain a straight line?

Carolyn is planning out her final essay. The introduction will be 80 words, the conclusion will be some multiple of the length of the introduction, and each of the four body sections will be the same length. Her essay has to be 5000 words total, and each body section is 170 words long. What is the ratio of the length of the conclusion to the length of the introduction?
If x + (1 / x) = √55, what is the value of r = x² + (1 / x)²?

A certain amount of pure salt must be added to a 10% solution of salt and water to increase it to a 30% solution. If \( \frac{106}{7} \) kg of pure salt is added, what is the initial weight of the salt and water solution?
Mike collected twenty-six cans to recycle on Monday and twenty-seven more on Tuesday. How many cans did Mike collect all together?
Find the cost of fencing around a circular field at the rate of Rs. 3 a meter. If the total cost of fencing is Rs. 159π, what is the diameter of the field?
Pam is currently one-fifth as old as Rena. In 53 years, Rena will be three times as old as Pam. How old is Pam now?

When 53 moles of Acetic acid (CH3COOH) are reacted with 60 moles of Sodium hydroxide (NaOH) in a solution where the acetic acid partially ionizes into acetate ions and H+ ions under equilibrium conditions, find out the number of moles of resultant Sodium acetate (CH3COONa). Allan and Jake brought some balloons to the park. Allan brought 31 balloons, and Jake brought 22 balloons. How many balloons did they bring to the park altogether?
Bobby ate 36 pieces of candy. Then, he ate 17 more. Bobby ate _____ pieces of candy.

An agricultural cooperative must ship 6500 kg of potatoes. During transport by truck, 140 kg are damaged and therefore cannot be sold. The potatoes are distributed into bags of equal weight, each bag being sold for $72. The sale of the potatoes brings $8640. What is the weight of each bag in kg?

Traveling from Manhattan to the Bronx, Andrew rides the subway for 10 hours, takes the train and rides for some time, and then bikes the remaining distance for 8 hours. The total time he takes to reach the Bronx from Manhattan is 548 hours. What is the ratio of the time Andrew spends on the train to the time he spends on the subway?
A ribbon is cut into 100 pieces, each 15 centimeters long, and after cutting, 38 meters of ribbon remains. What was the original length of the ribbon in meters?

The population of a city is 100 at the beginning of the first year. It decreases by 20% at the end of the first year, increases by 25% at the end of the second year, and decreases by 47% at the end of the third year. What is the population at the end of the third year?
Dividing 3 times a certain number by 5, subtracting 6.8, and multiplying that by 4 resulted in 100. Find that number.
For what value of \(x\) is \(2^3 \cdot 3^x = 8 \cdot 3^{53}\)?

Katrina has 116 cookies to sell at her bakery. She plans to take home any cookies she doesn’t sell by the end of the day. In the morning, she sells 3 dozen cookies. During the lunch rush, she sells some cookies. In the afternoon, she sells 16 more cookies. She has 11 cookies left to take home. How many cookies did she sell during the lunch rush?
A man buys a book and sells it for Rs 74.2. The rate of profit is 40%. What is the cost price of the book?

Jenny likes to play board games with her friends. She likes to play against her friend Mark the most, as she's played him 54 times and Mark has won a certain number of times. She doesn't like playing Jill, as she's played her twice as many times as she's played Mark and Jill has won 75% of them. Jenny has won board games with her two friends 28 times in total. How many times has Mark won against Jenny?
A woman swims downstream 336 km and upstream 300 km taking 6 hours each time. What is the speed of the woman in still water?
Find the number of moles of Chloromethane formed on combining some moles of Methane and 53 moles of Chlorine. The number of moles of Chloromethane formed is 53. How many moles of Methane were used?
a, b, c hired a car for Rs. 544 and used it for 7, 8, and 53 hours respectively. The hire charges paid by b were Rs. 64. How many hours did c use the car?
A 212 meter rope was cut into 3 parts in the ratio of 3:4:5. How long is the shortest part?

Tim came second in math. When his mother asked him how much he had scored, he answered that he got the sum of the first 5 prime numbers plus 25. His mother immediately worked out the answer. How much had he scored in math?

When 227 is divided by a certain divisor, the remainder obtained is 15. When 202 is divided by the same divisor, the remainder obtained is 43. However, when the sum of the two numbers 227 and 202 is divided by the divisor, the remainder obtained is 5. What is the value of the divisor?

Hazel and her father both love going on fishing trips. This year, they planned to go around the Great Lakes for a unique fishing experience. Their first stop is Lake Ontario. Hazel and her father decided to have a contest between them. If Hazel caught 26 salmons and her dad caught 27, how many salmons did they catch in total?
A sum fetched a total simple interest of Rs. 21.2 at the rate of 10% p.c.p.a. in 4 years. What is the sum?
A quadrilateral has a diagonal of 53 cm, and the perpendicular offsets from the other two vertices to this diagonal are 1 cm and 1 cm. Find its area.
David obtained 45 marks in English, 35 in Mathematics, 52 in Physics, 47 in Chemistry, and some marks in Biology. His average marks are 46.4. What are his marks in Biology?
The diagonals of a rhombus are 10.6 m and 10 m. What is its area?
Albert is 2 times Mary’s age and 2 times as old as Betty. Mary is 53 years younger than Albert. How old is Betty?
Nancy went to 20 football games this month. She went to 18 games last month, and plans to go to 15 games next month. She paid 3 dollars for the tickets. In all, she would attend _____ games.
A light flashes every 30 seconds. How many times does it flash in 26 minutes?
He needs wax to stick the feathers together. The feathers require 199 g of wax. He needs 146 more grams of wax. How many grams of wax does he have right now?
A rectangular field is to be fenced on three sides, leaving a side of 23 feet uncovered. If the area of the field is 345 square feet, how many feet of fencing will be required?
