Sandy gets 3 marks for each correct sum and loses 2 marks for each incorrect sum. Sandy attempts 31 sums and gets 23 sums correct. How many marks did Sandy obtain in total?
Among the 64 flowers, 5 were given to Min-Young and 6 to Yoo-Jeong. How many flowers are left?

Caleb bought 17 cartons of ice cream and some cartons of frozen yoghurt. Each carton of ice cream cost $1 and each carton of frozen yoghurt cost $1. Caleb spent $36 more on ice cream than on frozen yoghurt. How many cartons of frozen yoghurt did Caleb buy?

Christina records her mood every day on a calendar. Over the past one hundred days of moods, she had fifty-one good days, twenty bad days, and the rest were neutral. Her first thirty days were good, her next twenty days were bad, and her next twenty days were neutral. If the next three days were good, neutral, and good, how many good days were there in total?

Rates for having a manuscript typed at a certain typing service are $5 per page for the first time a page is typed and $3 per page each time a page is revised. A certain manuscript has a specific number of pages, of which 30 were revised only once, 20 were revised twice, and the rest required no revisions. The total cost of having the manuscript typed was $475. How many pages does the manuscript have?

Elvis, Ralph, and Zoey are to make square and triangular shapes with matchsticks from a box containing 103 matchsticks. Elvis makes 4-matchstick squares with no shared sides, Ralph makes 8-matchstick squares in a 2x2 grid pattern, and Zoey makes equilateral triangles using 7 matchsticks that have no shared sides. If Elvis can only use a maximum of 20 matchsticks, Ralph can only use a maximum of 20 matchsticks, Zoey can only use a maximum of 15 matchsticks, and they can only create a total of 9 combined shapes, how many matchsticks will be left in the box after they create the maximum number of allowed shapes?

In the Golden State Team, each player earned points. Draymond earned 10 points, Curry earned twice the points as Draymond, Kelly earned 6, Durant earned twice the points as Kelly, Klay earned half the points as Draymond. How many points did the Golden State Team have in total?
If one fourth of the engines are defective, and there are some batches of 80 engines each. There are 3180 engines that are not defective. How many batches of engines are there?
Allan brought 4 balloons and Jake brought 60 balloons to the park. Allan then bought 3 more balloons at the park. How many more balloons did Jake have than Allan in the park?
A shopkeeper sold a book offering a discount of 10% and earned a profit of 37.7%. What would have been the percentage of profit earned if no discount was offered?

Three frogs are trying to hop across the road. The first frog takes twice as many hops as the second. The second frog takes 53 times as many hops as the third. The three frogs took a total of 160 hops. How many hops did it take the second frog to cross the road?
If some men take 15 days to complete a job, 15 men can finish that work in 53 days. How many men were in the first group?
A shop has a dimension of 3 feet × 4 feet. The annual rent per square foot of the shop is Rs. 53. What is the monthly rent of the shop?

The average earning of a mechanic for the first 4 days of a week is Rs. 18 and for the last 4 days is Rs. 32. He earns a certain amount on the fourth day. His average earning for the whole week is Rs. 21. How much does he earn on the fourth day?

The length of a rectangular landscape is 53/5 times its breadth. There is a playground in it whose area is 53 square meters and which is 1/5 of the total landscape. What is the length of the landscape?

A man sitting in a train traveling at 16 kmph observes that a goods train, traveling in the opposite direction, passes him. The goods train is 530 m long and its speed is 20 kmph. How many seconds does it take for the goods train to pass the man?

One night, 25 percent of the female officers on a police force were on duty. If a certain number of police officers were on duty that night and half of these were female officers, there were 106 female officers on the police force. How many police officers were on duty that night?
Ned was trying to expand his game collection. He bought 40 games from a friend and bought 51 more at a garage sale. If 38 of the games didn't work, how many good games did he end up with?

A certain grass seed mixture contains 50 percent timothy. If the amount of the mixture needed to plant one acre contains some pounds of timothy, and 15 acres can be planted with 1,590 pounds of the seed mixture, how many pounds of timothy are needed to plant one acre?

Apples cost a fixed amount per kilogram for the first 30 kilograms and a different amount per kilogram for each additional kilogram. The price of 33 kilograms is 400 rupees and for 36 kilograms is 559 rupees. What is the cost per kilogram for each additional kilogram after the first 30 kilograms?
In a class of 265 students, 3/5 went away to do painting, 1/5 went to play in the field. How many students are left in the classroom?
A sum of money is divided among A, B, and C so that for every Rs. 20 A has, B has Rs. 15 and C has Rs. 18. If C’s share is Rs. 18, find the total sum.
Frank was reading through some books. Each book had 159 pages and it took Frank 3 days to finish each book. How many pages did he read per day?

Tom decides to open a theater. He knows it will cost $5 per square foot of space that he needs and he needs 12 square feet for every seat in his theater. He wants a certain number of seats in his theater. He also realizes construction will cost twice as much as the land. He has a partner who covers 40% of the cost. Tom spends $5,724. How many seats does he want in his theater?
A number was chosen and divided by some value. Then, 160 was subtracted from the result and the final answer was 12. The chosen number was 9116. What was the value the number was divided by?
Mr. Thompson has 15 cats, Mrs. Sheridan has 11 cats, Mrs. Garrett has 24 cats, and Mr. Ravi has 3 cats. What's the combined total of all the cats owned by these four people?
A decimal number, 0.53, is converted into a vulgar fraction. What is the numerator of the resulting fraction?
Find the larger of two numbers whose sum is a certain value and whose difference is 15. The larger number is 34. What is the sum of the two numbers?
The perimeter of a triangle is some length and the inradius of the triangle is 5.0 cm. The area of the triangle is 132.5 cm². What is the perimeter of the triangle?
Tim had 58 cents. He paid a certain amount for a candy bar and got 5 cents change. How much did the candy bar cost?
10 pens and 20 pencils were purchased for 570. If the average price of a pencil was 2.00, find the average price of a pen.
The area of a triangle with a base of 8 m and a certain height is 212 square meters. What is the length of the height?
For the positive integers \(x\), \(x+2\), \(x+4\), \(x+7\), and \(x+272\), the mean is how much greater than the median?

At the fair, Adam bought 13 tickets. After riding the ferris wheel, he had 4 tickets left. Each ticket cost a certain amount, and Adam spent 477 dollars riding the ferris wheel. How much did each ticket cost?
A sum of money is sufficient to pay x's wages for 54 days and y's wages for 2862 days. The same money is sufficient to pay the wages of both for how many days?
Sandy sold lemonade in her neighborhood. She got some half-dollars on Saturday and 7 half-dollars on Sunday. Sandy received $30.00. How many half-dollars did she get on Saturday?

A warehouse store sells cartons of gum. Each carton contains 5 packs of gum, and there are some sticks of gum in each pack. Each brown box contains 4 cartons of gum. There are 8480 sticks of gum in 8 brown boxes. How many sticks of gum are in each pack?

In a chess tournament, there are 3 rounds. In the first round, 17 games are played. In the second round, 19 games are played. In the third round, 17 games are played. How many games were played in total?

Tom drives from town A to town B at a certain speed. From town B, Tom immediately continues to town C. The distance between A and B is 53 miles, and the distance between B and C is 2 miles. The average speed of the whole journey was 50 miles per hour. If Tom's speed driving from B to C is 20 miles per hour, what is his speed driving from A to B?
The average of 20, 40, and 36 is 4 more than the average of 53, 28, and 3. What is the first number in the second set?

A family is going to the amusement park. The adult tickets cost $22 for admission, and the tickets for children cost a certain amount. The family consists of 2 adults and 2 children. The total price the family will pay for admission is $150. What is the cost of a child's ticket?
Lisa rented some DVDs for $63.6. Each DVD costs $1.2 to rent. How many DVDs did Lisa rent?
92 campers went rowing in the morning, 39 campers went rowing in the afternoon, and 31 campers went rowing in the evening. How many more campers went rowing in the morning than in the afternoon?
What is the least prime number greater than 51 that will have a remainder of 2 when divided by 51?
A man has some hens and cows. If the number of heads is 80 and the number of feet equals 214, and there must be at least 10 hens and 5 cows, then how many hens are there?
There are 65 different books and 10 different movies in the 'crazy silly school' series. You read 12 of the books and watched 56 of the movies. How many more books do you still have to read?

Timothy decides he wants to start living off the land. He buys some acres of land for $20 an acre. He then builds himself a large house for $120,000. After that, he gets himself 20 cows for $1000 per cow and 100 chickens for $5 per chicken. The last thing is solar panels which take 6 hours to install with an installation cost of $100 an hour and then a flat fee of $6000 for the equipment. Everything cost him $148,160. How many acres of land did he buy?

Bret takes a 59 hour train ride to go to Boston. He spends 2 hours reading a book, 1 hour to eat his dinner, and some time watching movies on his computer. He has 3 hours left to take a nap. How long does he spend watching movies on his computer?
How many moles of NaCl are required to react with KI to form 53 moles of KCl along with 53 moles of NaI?

A can finish a job alone in 120 days. A and B together can finish it in 60 days. They work together for some days, then B leaves. After another 14 days, A finishes the remaining work. For how many days did A and B work together?

Sheila works 8 hours per day on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, and 6 hours per day on Tuesday and Thursday. She does not work on Saturday and Sunday. She earns $1908 per week. How much does she earn in dollars per hour?

In 1 week, a music store sold 9 guitars. Electric guitars sold for 7 dollars each and acoustic guitars sold for 5 dollars each. The store sold 4 electric guitars. What was the total amount of money earned from selling these guitars?

The tax on a commodity is diminished by 20% but its consumption is increased by some percent. The percent increase in the revenue derived from it is 22.4%. What is the percent by which the consumption of the commodity is increased?
A certain percentage of 100 is taken, then 20 is subtracted from it, and the result is 33. What is the percentage taken?

A dog travelled for 6.3 hours. He covered the first half of the distance at 10 km/h and the remaining half at a certain speed. The dog travelled a total distance of 106 km. What was the speed of the dog during the second half of the distance?

Barbie and Bruno have a pile of 732 coconuts that they need to move from one side of their yard to the other side. Barbie can carry a certain number of coconuts at a time, while Bruno can carry 8 coconuts at a time. They make 12 trips together carrying their maximum number of coconuts each time. How many coconuts can Barbie carry at a time?
A circular field has a diameter of 14 m. The cost of fencing around it is Rs. 742π. What is the rate per meter?
My car gets a certain number of miles per gallon of gas. If Grandma's house is 265 miles away, and it takes 5 gallons of gas to get there, how many miles per gallon does my car get?

A publishing house decides to create a contest for new writers and will award a total of $623 in prizes to the 18 novels with the most votes. The first place will get some money, second place will get $150, third place $120 and the rest of the awards will be paid with the same amount of money, $20 each. How much money will the first place winner get?

Tabitha caught 20 pieces of candy at the Christmas parade. Stan caught some pieces, Julie caught half the amount of candy as Tabitha, and Carlos caught twice as much candy as Stan. The friends caught a total of 189 pieces of candy. How many pieces did Stan catch?
A 265-meter long train crosses a man standing on the platform in 18 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
Jesse has 50 square feet of carpet. Her room is 4 feet long and of certain width. She needs 162 more square feet of carpet to cover the whole floor. What is the width of her room?

The time taken by a man to row his boat upstream is twice the time taken by him to row the same distance downstream. If the speed of the boat in still water is 159 kmph, what is the speed of the stream?
There are many fish in the tank. One third of them are blue, and half of the blue fish have spots. There are 318 fish in the tank. How many of the blue fish have spots?

In one week, Jake can eat 3 papayas, his brother can eat some papayas, and his father can eat 4 papayas. To account for 4 weeks, Jake needs to buy 240 papayas from the farmer's market. How many papayas can Jake's brother eat in one week?
An avant-garde sushi house sells jellyfish for a certain amount and eel for nine times that amount. If the eel costs $47.70, what is the combined cost of one order each kind of sushi?

A seminar is offered to a school for their teachers. The regular seminar fee is $5 per teacher. The school registered 10 teachers for the seminar a week before the schedule, and it also released a $0.30 food allowance for each teacher. How much did the school spend in all?
A baker had 71 cupcakes and sold 18 of them. How many cupcakes are left?

Seonho wants to cut 1 large cube of wood into several small cubes of wood. The length of a side of a small block of wood is 1/4 of the length of a side of a block of large wood. After cutting, 11 of the small blocks are used for another project. Find the number of small wooden blocks that are left.
There were 73 bales of hay in the barn. Jason stacked some bales in the barn today. Now there are 126 bales of hay in the barn. How many bales did he store in the barn?

A community is building a metal fence. Each fence panel is made of 3 metal sheets and a certain number of metal beams. The fence is made of 20 panels. Each sheet is made of 10 metal rods and each metal beam is made of 4 metal rods. The community needs 4840 metal rods for the fence. How many metal beams are in each fence panel?
A library has 97 books. After donating some, 44 are left. How many books were donated?
At an examination in which full marks were 100, D scored full marks. C got 20% less than D, B got 25% more than C, and A got 47% less than B. How many marks did A get?
Of the 100 people in a room, 3/5 are women. If 47% of the people are married, what is the maximum number of women in the room who could be unmarried?
Fran baked 54 red macaroons and 20 green macarons. How many macaroons will remain if Fran ate 7 green macaroons and twice as many red macaroons as green macaroons?
If \(x+y = 2\) and \(x^2-y^2 = 106\), then what is \(x-y\)?

Ned was helping the cafeteria workers pick up lunch trays, but he could only carry twenty trays at a time. He had to pick up twenty-seven trays from one table and some trays from another. He made 4 trips. How many trays did he pick up from the second table?
There are 99 balls in a jar, 61 of which are blue. You add some blue balls, and now the probability of picking a blue ball is 3/4. How many blue balls did you add?
Of the 61 students, 8 are girls. How many male students are there?
(53x)(x) = ax² + kx + n. What is the value of a - n + k?

Samuel is driving to San Francisco's Comic-Con in his car and he needs to travel 848 miles to the hotel where he made a reservation. At first, he drives at 60 miles/hour for 2 hours straight. Heavy rain starts, forcing Samuel to slow down to 40 miles/hour for the next hour. After the rain stops, he takes a 30-minute break. 

He then speeds up to 70 miles/hour for 3 hours, but due to traffic, he only maintains this speed for 2 hours and 30 minutes. He takes a 1 hour break before switching to a different car. In the new vehicle, he drives at 50 miles/hour for 4 hours before stopping at a friend's place for a 2-hour break. 

Upon leaving his friend's place, Samuel switches to a motorcycle and maintains a speed of 80 miles/hour for the first hour. However, the motorcycle begins to malfunction, and he is forced to reduce his speed to 60 miles/hour for the next 3 hours. How far is he from the hotel?
A can do a piece of work in 53 days. A does the work for 5 days only and leaves the job. B does the remaining work in 48 days. In how many days B alone can do the work?

John and Steve are speed walkers in a race. John is 50 meters behind Steve when he begins his final push. John blazes to the finish at a pace of 5 m/s, while Steve maintains a steady 4 m/s. If John finishes the race 3 meters ahead of Steve, how long was John's final push in seconds?
Ruel has two books of 10 stamps and three books of 11 stamps. How many stamps does Ruel have?

Two trains, A and B, started simultaneously from opposite ends of a 57-mile route and traveled toward each other on parallel tracks. Train A, traveling at a constant rate, completed the trip in some hours; Train B, traveling at a constant rate, completed the trip in 4 hours. Train A had traveled 4 miles when it met Train B. How many hours did it take for Train A to complete the trip?
27 is subtracted from 80% of a number, and the result is a certain value. The number is 100. What is the value of the result?
Given that the areas of three adjacent faces of a cuboidal box are 8 cm², 9 cm², and 9.5 cm² respectively, and each pair of opposite faces have the same area, find the total surface area of the box.
A jeweler has 71 gold medallions and sells 18 of them. How many medallions are left?

k is faster than l by a certain percentage. If l starts at 9 a.m. and k starts at 10 a.m., l travels at a speed of 50 km/hr. If l and k are 303 kms apart, they meet when they travel in opposite directions at 12. What is the percentage by which k is faster than l?

The average temperature in Orlando in a particular week was some degrees. If the temperature on each of the first 3 days in that week was 40, and the temperature for Thursday and Friday was 70 degrees each, the total temperature of the remaining days of that week was 111 degrees. What was the average temperature for that week?

If John makes a contribution to a charity fund at school, the average contribution size will increase by 50% reaching $39.75 per person. If there was 1 other contribution made before John's, what is the size of his donation?

You marked the halfway point of a 212 centimeters (cm) long wooden stick with a red pen. If you marked with a blue pen halfway from one end of the stick to the point marked with a red pen, find the length in centimeters (cm) between the point marked with a red pen and the point marked with a blue pen.

John had a stock of 1400 books in his bookshop. He sold 62 on Monday, 62 on Tuesday, some books on Wednesday, 48 on Thursday, and 40 on Friday. 81.07142857142857% of the books were not sold. How many books did he sell on Wednesday?

Anthony is sending out coupons for his pizza parlor through the mail. He wants to send out 100 small coupons and twice as many big coupons. If each small coupon costs 5 cents to mail and each big coupon costs 24 cents, how much does he spend on postage total?

Christi saw twice as many black bears as white bears and 3 more brown bears than black bears in a national park. If the number of black bears in the park is 20, calculate the population of bears in the park.
The diameter of a circle is 106 centimeters (cm). Then how long is the radius in centimeters (cm)?

When a merchant imported a certain item, she paid a 10 percent import tax on the portion of the total value of the item in excess of $50. If the amount of the import tax that the merchant paid was $0.30, what was the total value of the item?
If $\det \mathbf{A} = 5,$ then find $\det (\mathbf{A^3}) - 72$.
Compute $2^2 + 7^2$.
Carol starts with 28 blocks. She finds 25 more blocks. How many blocks does Carol end with?

At an auction event, the price of a TV, whose cost was $35, increased by 2/5 times its initial price. The price of a phone, which was $2, doubled from its original price. If Bethany had taken both items to the auction, calculate the total amount she received for the items after the sale at the auction.

Trenton sells electronic supplies. Each week he earns 5 dollars plus commission equal to 8% of his sales. This week he has a goal to earn a certain amount. He must make sales of at least 600 dollars to reach his goal. What is the amount he wants to earn this week?
Evaluate the expression \(a^2 + 4a + 8\) if \(a = 5\).

A rectangular block of dimensions 10 cm × 3 cm × 53 cm is completely immersed in a rectangular vessel containing water. The width of the base of the vessel is 15 cm, and the water level rises by 2 cm. What is the length of the base of the vessel?
Each turtle lays a clutch of some eggs. If 40% of the eggs successfully hatch, 5 turtles produce 106 hatchlings. How many eggs does each turtle lay?

In a market, a dozen eggs cost as much as a pound of rice, and a half-liter of kerosene costs as much as 6 eggs. If the cost of each pound of rice is $0.53, then how many cents does a liter of kerosene cost? [One dollar has 100 cents.]
Elise had $47. Then she saved $13 from her allowance and spent $2 on a comic book and some money on a puzzle. Now, Elise has $5 left. How much money did Elise spend on the puzzle?
When Hoseok bought 2 persimmons and 51 apples, how many fruits did Hoseok buy?

To decorate the tree, you made several triangles using wire. The length of the wire was 171 centimeters (cm) before the decoration, and the wire became 12 centimeters (cm) at the end. Given that each triangle had a side length of 1 centimeter (cm), how many triangles can be made?

Machine A and machine B process the same work at different rates. Machine C processes work as fast as machines A and B combined. Machine D processes work at a rate that is 54 times machine B's rate. Assume all 4 machines work at fixed unchanging rates. If machine A works alone on a job, it takes 49 hours and 30 minutes. When all 4 machines work together on the same job simultaneously, it takes them 1 minute to complete it. What is the ratio of machine D's work rate to machine C's work rate?
Billy has $25 less than twice the money Sam has. If Sam has $26, how much money do they have together?
Jake has $200. He spends $41 on a new motorcycle, and then spends half of what's left on a concert ticket. Jake then loses a third of what he has left. How much money does he have left?

Alice is making a big stack of dishes to see how tall she can make it before it topples over and falls. She starts off by placing 16 plates on top of each other. The tower holds fine so she adds 37 more plates. She is in the process of placing more and more plates when it finally topples over and crashes down. How many plates were in the stack when it toppled over and crashed?
While on vacation in New York, Greg went out for a lunch. If sales tax in New York is 4% and he left a 6% tip, Greg paid $58.30. How much did the lunch cost before tax and tip?
if 8 men can do a piece of work in 477 days, or 12 women can do it in 53 days, in how many days can the same work be done by 6 men and 11 women?

After Martha went grocery shopping she had 20 bottles of juice in the refrigerator and 18 bottles in the pantry. During the week Martha bought 25 more bottles of juice. If Martha and her family drank 10 bottles of juice during the week, how many bottles are left?

Each box of Christmas decorations contains 4 pieces of tinsel, 1 Christmas tree, and some snow globes. If 11 families receive a box of decorations and another box is given to the community center, 696 decorations have been handed out. How many snow globes are in each box?

A certain amount of cool-drink solution is made from 12% jasmine water. If 5 liters of jasmine and 13 liters of water were added to the solution, the solution is now 16% jasmine. What was the initial volume of the cool-drink solution?

There are 318 male and female participants in a meeting. Half the female participants and one-quarter of the male participants are democrats. One-third of all the participants are democrats. How many of the democrats are female?
In a bag of small balls, 1/4 are green, 1/16 are blue, 1/8 are yellow, and the remaining 477 are white. How many balls are blue?

Jerry’s two daughters play softball on different teams. One daughter has 8 games this season, and the other has 7 games. Each game lasts 2 hours. The first daughter’s team practices 2 hours for every game they play, and the second daughter’s team practices 1 hour for every game they play. How many hours will Jerry spend at the field watching his daughters play and practice altogether?

The school is planning a field trip. The school has 24 classrooms. There are 1272 students in the school with each classroom having the same number of students. There are 84 seats on each school bus. How many students are in each class?
What is the value of y if x + 2y = 117, x = 11, and y is the unknown?

A 100-liter solution of kola is made from 80% water, 6% concentrated kola, and the rest is made from sugar. If 14 liters of sugar, a certain amount of water, and 8 liters of concentrated kola were added to the solution, 16% of the solution is made from sugar. How many liters of water were added to the solution?
Carrie likes to buy t-shirts at the local clothing store. They cost $9.95 each. One day, she bought some t-shirts and spent $527.35. How many t-shirts did she buy?

Kira's cat eats a pound of kibble every few hours. Kira fills her cat's bowl with 5 pounds of kibble before going on a long trip. When she returns, she weighs the bowl and there is still 3 pounds left. Kira was away from home for 106 hours. How many hours does it take for Kira's cat to eat a pound of kibble?
Josh buys 2 packs of string cheese. Each piece of string cheese costs 5 cents. Each pack has the same number of string cheeses. He paid $5.30. How many string cheeses are in each pack?

The guests at a rugby banquet consumed a total of 159 pounds of food. If no individual guest consumed more than 3 pounds of food, what is the minimum number of guests that could have attended the banquet?
A rectangular field is to be fenced on three sides leaving a side of 23 feet uncovered. If the area of the field is 345 sq. feet, how many feet of fencing will be required?
159 people are going to the zoo, and there are 3 buses to take people. How many people would go in each bus if the same number go in each one and all of the people go to the zoo?

In an election between four candidates, one received 40% of the total valid votes, another received 35% of the total valid votes, and the third candidate received 24% of the total valid votes. 20% of the votes were invalid. If the total number of votes was 6625, how many valid votes did the fourth candidate receive?
An article has a normal price and is sold after two successive discounts of 10% and 20%. The final price of the article is $38.16. What is the normal price of the article?

Adam has some balls. 20 balls are red, 13 are blue, and the rest are either pink or orange. There are 3 times as many pink as orange balls, and there are 5 orange balls. How many balls does Adam have in total?
What number can be added to both the numerator and denominator of \(\frac{3}{5}\) so that the resulting fraction will be equivalent to \(\frac{28}{29}\)?
Anna used one baking tray to bake 53 cupcakes. If she sold all of them for $1 each, how much did she earn?
Some persons can repair a road in 12 days, working 5 hours a day. 10 persons, working 6 hours a day, can complete the same work in 53 days. How many persons are in the first group?
Let n = 2^53. How many even positive divisors does n have?
A train 47 m long traveling at 36 km/h takes 10 seconds to cross a bridge. How long is the bridge in meters?

A garrison of 1000 men has provisions for 80 days. After a certain number of days, a reinforcement of 350 men arrives, and it is now found that the provisions will last only for 20 days more. How many days passed before the reinforcement arrived?
Georgia has 4 yellow buttons, 2 black buttons, and some green buttons. She gives 54 buttons to Mary, and she has 5 left. How many green buttons does Georgia have?

Jinwoo and Seongmin can do 28/53 of the work if they work together for 8 days. The two of them did this together for 8 days, and the rest was done by Jinwoo alone for 10 days. How many days will it take if Seongmin finishes this task by himself from the beginning?
Given that $2^x+ 2^x+ 2^x+ 2^x= 2^{55}$, what is the value of $x$?

Out of a group of 200 people, 28 friends attend a movie, 22 attend a picnic, and 18 attend a gaming event. There are 8 who attend both the movie and picnic, 4 who attend the movie and gaming event, and 6 who attend the picnic and gaming event. There are 3 friends who attend all three events. How many friends are there in total who attend at least one of the events?
A certain sum of money is divided among a, b and c so that for each Rs. a has, b has 88 paisa and c has 212 paisa. If the total sum of money is Rs. 100, what is c's share?

The speed of a boat in standing water is some kmph, and the speed of the stream is 1.5 kmph. A man rows to a place at a distance of 106 km and comes back to the starting point. The total time taken by him is 4 hours. What is the speed of the boat in standing water?
John buys goods worth some amount. He gets a rebate of 6% on it. After getting the rebate, he pays sales tax at 10%. He has to pay Rs. 54.802 for the goods. What was the original price of the goods?
Hoseok is 7th from the left and 47th from the right in a single line. How many students are there?
The lengths of the three sides of a triangle are \(7\), \(x+4\), and \(2x+1\). The perimeter of the triangle is 90. What is the length of the longest side of the triangle?
The price of a coat in a certain store is $106. If the price of the coat is to be reduced by 50%, what is the amount by which the price is reduced?

In Cliff’s impressive rock collection, there are 30 igneous rocks and 23 sedimentary rocks. Of the igneous rocks, 2/3 are shiny and the rest are matte, while 1/5 of the sedimentary rocks are shiny. If there are 20 shiny igneous rocks, how many total rocks does Cliff have?

Ali has a store that sells fruits and vegetables. He puts 23 kg of kidney apples, 37 kg of golden apples and 29 kg of Canada apples on the shelves. By noon, 36 kg of apples were sold. What is the mass of apples that he has left?
A plumber bought 10 meters of copper pipe and some plastic pipe. Each meter costs $4. The plumber spent $292 in total. How many more meters of plastic pipe than copper pipe did the plumber buy?

Adam has three more than twice as many tattoos as Jason has. Jason has four tattoos on each of his arms, six tattoos on each of his legs, and five tattoos on his head. How many tattoos does Adam have?
Barbara has some candies. She buys 18 more and now has 71 candies in all. How many candies did Barbara have initially?

Twelve people are at a party. Each person shakes hands with everyone except two people, but one person skips three people instead. How many handshakes occur?
A cricketer scored 448 runs which included some boundaries and 2 sixes. He made 50 percent of his total score by running between the wickets. How many boundaries did he hit?
A compound has a certain number of carbon atoms and 1 oxygen atom. The molecular weight of the compound is 652. How many carbon atoms are in the compound?
Jesse's room is some feet long and 8 feet wide. She needs 424 square feet of carpet to cover the whole floor. How long is Jesse's room?
If 20 men take 53 days to complete a job, in how many days can 20 men finish that work?

Seymour runs a plant shop with 4 flats of petunias with 8 petunias per flat, 3 flats of roses, each containing a certain number of roses, and two Venus flytraps. Each petunia needs 8 ounces of fertilizer, each rose needs 3 ounces of fertilizer, and each Venus flytrap needs 2 ounces of fertilizer. Seymour needs 737 ounces of fertilizer in total. How many roses are in each flat?

During a race transmitted on television, five advertisements were shown, lasting the same number of minutes each. One minute of advertising costs $4000. The cost of transmitting these advertisements during the race was $1,060,000. How long did each advertisement last?
Darwin initially has $212. He spent 1/4 of it on gas for his car, 1/3 of what was left on food, and 1/2 of the remaining amount on clothing. How much money did he have left?
A chef used 48 potatoes to make fries for the lunch crowd. Later he used another 5 potatoes for the dinner crowd. How many potatoes did he use total?

In a class of 15 students, the average age is 18 years. The students are divided into three groups: 1) 5 students with average age 11, 2) 6 students with average age 18, 3) 3 students with average age 18. Use weighted averages to find the age of the 15th student.

Barbara asked the butcher for some steaks that cost $16.00 per pound. She also asked for a pound and a half of chicken breasts that were $8.00 a pound. She spent $65 at the butcher. How many ounces of steaks did she buy?
A boat having a certain length and breadth of 2 m is floating on a lake. The boat sinks by 1 cm when a man with a mass of 1060 kg gets on it. What is the length of the boat?
Mudit's age 33 years hence will be twice his age 10 years ago. Find Mudit's present age.
Eric has a chicken farm with some chickens. His chickens lay 3 eggs each day. After 3 days, Eric collected 477 eggs. How many chickens does Eric have on his farm?
At a pool party, there are 5 pizzas cut into 12 slices each. If the guests eat some slices and there are 7 slices left, how many slices did the guests eat?

There are some students trying out for the school's trivia teams. If 11 of them didn't get picked for the team and the rest were put into 3 groups with 14 students in each group, how many students tried out for the trivia teams?

a and b are 106 km apart. They start to move towards each other simultaneously, a at speed 10 km/hr and b at 10 km/hr. If every hour they double their speed, what is the distance that a passes until he meets b?

Omar and Karen made egg rolls to share at the school potluck. Omar rolled 116 egg rolls. Karen rolled some egg rolls. The total number of egg rolls Omar and Karen rolled is 169. How many egg rolls did Karen roll?

Dalton, Hunter, Alex, Bella, and Chris formed a Superhero Fan Club. They set a goal to watch as many Superhero movies as they could in one summer. Dalton watched 15 movies, Hunter watched 19, Alex watched 15, Bella watched 21, and Chris watched 11. They all watched 5 superhero movies together, while Dalton, Hunter, and Alex watched an additional 3 movies only among themselves, and Bella and Chris watched 2 more movies only with each other. Every other movie they watched was different. How many different movies did they see?

A train leaves Mumbai at 9 am at a certain speed. After one hour, another train leaves Mumbai in the same direction as that of the first train at a speed of 106 kmph. The two trains meet at a distance of 106 km from Mumbai. What is the speed of the first train?

In the baking contest, three times as many people voted for the unicorn cake compared to the witch cake, and the dragon cake received 53 more votes than the witch cake. If 7 people voted for the witch cake and there were 88 votes cast total, how many more votes did the dragon cake receive compared to the witch cake?

A polling company surveyed a certain number of households. They found that 20 spent at least $100 per month on both gasoline and electricity, 8 spent at least $100 per month on gasoline but not on electricity, and for every household that did not spend at least $100 per month on gasoline or electricity, 4 spent at least $100 per month on electricity but not on gasoline. There were 5 households that did not spend at least $100 per month on either gasoline or electricity. How many households were surveyed?
A cricket player has played some innings with an average of 36 runs. He must make 252 runs in his next innings to increase his average of runs by 4. How many innings has he played so far?
Walking at 53/46 of his usual rate, a boy reaches his school 7 minutes early. What is his usual time to reach the school?
What is the greatest two-digit whole number, the product of whose digits is 15?

Janet works as an exterminator and she also sells molten metal casts of fire ant nests on the Internet. Janet gets paid $4 an hour for exterminator work and makes $1/pound on her ant nest sculptures. If she does 10 hours of exterminator work and sells a 5-pound sculpture and an 8-pound sculpture, how much money does she make?

Daliah picked up 68.5 pounds of garbage. Dewei picked up some pounds less than Daliah. Zane picked up 4 times as many pounds of garbage as Dewei. Zane picked up 62 pounds of garbage. How many pounds less garbage did Dewei pick up compared to Daliah?

Car A runs at the speed of 106 km/hr and reaches its destination in 10 hours. Car B runs at a certain speed and reaches its destination in 10 hours. The respective ratio of distances covered by Car A and Car B is 2. What is the speed of Car B?

Jason initially had 20 violet balloons and 10 red balloons. He decided to give away 1/4 of his violet balloons and 1/2 of his red balloons to his friends at a party. Later that day, his friend gifted him another 32 violet balloons and Jason managed to find 1/5th as many red balloons as he had left. How many balloons does Jason have now?

Nancy has a bag containing some tortilla chips. She gives 7 tortilla chips to her brother and 5 tortilla chips to her sister, keeping 41 for herself. How many tortilla chips were in the bag initially?

The central Texas countryside contains many toads that come out at night. For every green toad, there are some brown toads, and one-quarter of the brown toads are spotted. There are 106 spotted brown toads per acre and 8 green toads per acre. How many brown toads are there for every green toad?
If \( x \) is equal to the sum of the integers from 4 to 10, inclusive, and \( y \) is the number of even integers from 4 to 10, inclusive, what is the value of \( x + y \)?
If Leo gains 2 pounds, he will weigh 50% more than his sister Kendra. Leo's current weight is 31 pounds. What is their combined weight currently?

The distance from city A to city B is 2756 miles. While driving from city A to city B, Cara drives at a constant speed of 52 miles per hour. Dan leaves city A 60 minutes after Cara. What is the minimum constant speed in miles per hour that Dan must exceed in order to arrive in city B before Cara?
A car tire makes approximately 31680/(53π) revolutions when the car travels 0.5 mile. What is the diameter of the tire?

John had 1750 books in his bookshop. He sold 70 on Monday, 70 on Tuesday, 70 on Wednesday, some books on Thursday, and 77 on Friday. 141/175 of the books were not sold. How many books did he sell on Thursday?
find the value of 53 × 1 = m ?
Carolyn practices the piano for 20 minutes a day and the violin for three times as long. Over a certain number of days, she practices a total of 4240 minutes. How many days does she practice?

Josh and Anna were both born on August 17th, but in different years. They got married on August 17 when Josh turned a certain age. Today, they're celebrating 30 years of marriage and their combined age is exactly 3 times what Josh's age was when they married. Anna was 46 when they got married. How old was Josh when they got married?

One night, 21 female officers were on duty, which was 21/53 of all the female officers on the force. If these female officers made up half of all officers on duty that night, how many female officers were on the police force?
36 men can complete a piece of work in 106 days. If a smaller group of men work on the same task, they can complete it in 72 days. How many men are in the smaller group?

In a college, the ratio of boys to girls in Class A is 2:3. If there are 12 girls in Class A, how many total students are in Class A? Class B has a boys-to-girls ratio of 1:2 and a total of 33 students. Find the total number of students in the college considering both Class A and Class B.

Dave bought a large pack of french fries and ate fourteen before a hungry seagull stole the pack out of his hand. When the seagull landed, he gobbled down twelve french fries. Then three pigeons bullied him away from the food, and each pigeon ate three fries. Later, a raccoon stole two thirds of the remaining fries. Ants carried off a final french fry, leaving five behind. How many french fries were in the pack when Dave bought it?

A bear is hunting for her cubs and herself. She needs 1710 pounds of meat for herself in a week. Each cub needs 500 pounds a week, and she has 4 cubs. She hunts daily, and needs to catch 10 animals each day. How much does each animal weigh?
A compound has 1 Al atom and some Cl atoms. The molecular weight is 1908.5. How many Cl atoms are in the compound?

Simeon drinks a certain amount of filtered water every day. He used to drink it in 1-ounce servings, but now he drinks it in 53-ounce servings. It now takes Simeon 52 fewer servings per day to drink his water than it used to. How many fluid ounces of water does Simeon drink every day?
In a court-mandated traffic class, there are 7 drunk drivers and 3 less than 7 times that many speeders. How many students are there in total?
Taehyung's uncle is 17 years older than Taehyung. Four years later, the sum of Taehyung's age and his uncle's age is 131 years old. How old is Taehyung this year?

Parker went to the gym and found 5 dumbbells of a certain weight set up for weightlifting. He added two more dumbbells to the setup and started his exercises. Parker is using 371 pounds of dumbbells for his exercises. What is the weight of each dumbbell?
26 children were riding on the bus. At the bus stop, 27 more children got on the bus. How many children are on the bus now?

A wild birdseed mix is made by combining 212 lb. of millet seed costing $0.60 per lb. with sunflower seeds costing $1.10 per pound. How many pounds of sunflower seeds are needed to make a mixture that costs $0.70 per lb?

Alfred is storing 3 tonnes of maize each month for the next 2 years. If a certain amount of maize is stolen and 8 tonnes are given to him as a donation, he has 27 tonnes of maize at the end of the 2 years. How many tonnes of maize were stolen?

A company that ships boxes to a certain number of distribution centers uses color coding to identify each center. If either a single color or a pair of two different colors is chosen to represent each center, and if each center is uniquely represented by that choice of one or two colors, the minimum number of colors needed for the coding is 10. However, two specific pairs of colors are considered too similar and are not allowed to be used. How many distribution centers are there?
A boy takes 76.32 seconds to run round a square field of a certain length, if he runs at the rate of 10 km/hr. What is the length of each side of the square field?

The average height of 5 boys in a class was calculated as 179 cm. It was later found that the height of one of the boys was wrongly written as a certain height whereas his actual height was 48 cm. The actual average height of the boys in the class is 178 cm. What was the wrongly written height of the boy?

In the orchard of the Grange Poser farm, there are 30 apple trees that each give a certain amount of apples and 50 peach trees that each produce an average of 60 kg of fruit. The total mass of fruit harvested in this orchard is 4590 kg. How many kilograms of apples does each apple tree give?
How many moles of Sodium bicarbonate are required to react with Hydrochloric acid to form 53 moles of Water, 53 moles of Carbon dioxide, and 53 moles of Sodium chloride?

A boy runs at a constant speed of 18 mph for some hours and then covers the next 70 miles at an average speed of 10 mph. The total duration of his running is 60 hours. How many hours did he run at his initial speed?

a can alone do a work in 106 days, and b alone can do the same work in 106 days. How many days will they take to complete the work together?

For any number y, y* is defined as the greatest positive even integer less than or equal to y. What is the sum of 27 and its corresponding y* value?

Initially, the men and women in a room were in the ratio of 4 : 5. Then, 2 men entered the room and some women left the room. Then, the number of women doubled. Now there are 54 men in the room and 24 women. How many women left the room?

A man sitting in a train which is traveling at a certain speed observes that a goods train, traveling in the opposite direction, takes 9 seconds to pass him. The goods train is 212.5 m long and its speed is 32 kmph. What is the speed of the train the man is sitting in?

A company has 530 employees. 60% of the employees drive to work, 30% take public transport, and the rest either cycle or walk. Among the walkers and cyclists, the ratio of those who walk to those who cycle is 0:1. How many employees cycle to work?
Last year, egg producers in Douglas County produced some eggs. This year, those same farms produced 4253 eggs, which is 4200 more eggs than last year. How many eggs did the farmers produce last year?

Brooke has 20 math problems, some social studies problems, and 12 science problems for homework. He can answer each math problem for 2 minutes, each social studies problem for 30 seconds, and each science problem for 1.5 minutes. It takes Brooke 84.5 minutes to answer all his homework. How many social studies problems does he have?
Big boxes contain 7 dolls each. Small boxes contain some dolls each. There are 5 big boxes and 9 small boxes. There are 512 dolls in total. How many dolls are there in each small box?

A farmer has an apple orchard consisting of Fuji and Gala apple trees. Due to some weather conditions, a certain percentage of his trees cross-pollinated. The number of his trees that are pure Fuji plus the cross-pollinated ones totals 159, while 1/2 of all his trees are pure Fuji. How many of his trees are pure Gala if the cross-pollination percentage is 25%?

Jackson buys a computer game for $18 and three movie tickets for $7 each. He also spends $5 on snacks and $3 on transportation for each movie trip. How much did he spend on entertainment and additional expenses total?

A zoo has 10 parrots. It has 3 times the number of snakes than parrots and 2 times the number of monkeys than snakes. The number of elephants is half the number of parrots and snakes added up, and there are 13 fewer zebras than elephants. What is the difference in number between the zebras and the monkeys?

If a man walks at the rate of 4 kmph, he misses a train by 80 minutes. However, if he walks at the rate of 5 kmph, he reaches the station 79 minutes before the arrival of the train. How far is the station from his starting point?
A train passes a platform in 12 seconds. The same train passes a man standing on the platform in 6.7 seconds. If the speed of the train is 36 km/hr, what is the length of the platform?

In 1998, the profits of company N were 10 percent of revenues. In 1999, the revenues of company N fell by a certain percentage, but profits were 20 percent of revenues. The profits in 1999 were 94 percent of the profits in 1998. By what percentage did the revenues fall in 1999?
The simple interest on a certain amount at a 7% rate for 14 years amounted to Rs 2597. The principal was Rs 2650. How much less was the simple interest than the principal?

A rectangular lawn has a certain length and a width of 60 m. It has two roads each 10 m wide running in the middle of the lawn, one parallel to the length and the other parallel to the breadth. The cost of traveling the two roads is Rs. 3090 at Rs. 3 per sq m. What is the length of the lawn?

Some persons can do a piece of work in a certain number of days. Two times the number of these people will do one fifth of that work in 5.3 days. How many days does it take for the original number of people to do the work?

An escalator moves towards the top level at the rate of 15 ft/sec and its length is 1060 feet. If a person walks on the moving escalator at the rate of 5 feet per second towards the top level, how much time does he take to cover the entire length?
Ryan has 20 slices of bread and his mom gives him 33 more slices. How many slices of bread does Ryan have in total?
Kelly has some Nintendo games. She needs to give away 31 games so that she will have 22 games left. How many Nintendo games does Kelly have initially?

Hazel and her father both love going on fishing trips. This year, they planned to go around the Great Lakes for a unique fishing experience. Their first stop is Lake Ontario. Hazel and her father decided to have a contest between them. Hazel caught 24 salmons and her dad caught some salmons. They caught a total of 77 salmons. How many salmons did her dad catch?
Bruce has 123 eggs. Kimberly has 17 eggs. Bruce loses 70 eggs. How many eggs will Bruce have?
Yoo-jeong borrowed some of the 61 notebooks from Min-young, and Min-young had 8 notebooks left. How many notebooks did Yoo-jeong borrow?

Emily was planting vegetables in her garden. She started with 126 seeds and planted 20 of them in the big garden and in each of her small gardens put 2 seeds each. How many small gardens did Emily have?

A cistern has a leak which would empty it in some minutes. A tap is turned on which admits 7 liters a minute into the cistern, and it is emptied in 60 minutes. The cistern holds 3180 liters. How many minutes would it take for the leak to empty the cistern without the tap turned on?
a and b together can finish a work in 52 days. a alone can do it in 2756 days. How many days will b alone take?

Macy, Piper, and Quinn went to the batting cages. Each token gets you 15 pitches. Macy used 11 tokens, Piper used 17 tokens, and Quinn used 13 tokens. Macy hit the ball 145 times, Piper hit the ball 237 times, and Quinn hit the ball 180 times. How many pitches did Macy, Piper, and Quinn miss altogether?

The average mark of the students of a class in a particular exam is 85. If 7 students whose average mark in that exam is 39 are excluded, the average mark of the remaining will be 92. Find the number of students who wrote the exam.

How much less rain did Greg experience while camping compared to the rainfall his friend experienced at his house?

A train moves with a speed of 190.8 kmph. What is its speed in meters per second?
A football team lost 7 yards and then gained 60. What is the team's net progress in yards?

The dimensions of a room are 10 feet * 6 feet * 5 feet. What is the cost of white washing the four walls of the room at Rs. 0.5 per square feet if there is one door of dimensions 6 feet * 3 feet and three windows of dimensions 4 feet * 3 feet each?
Fred grew 20 cantaloupes. Tim grew 33 cantaloupes. How many cantaloupes did they grow in total?

Paityn has 20 red hats and some blue hats. Her friend Zola has 4/5 times as many red hats as Paityn has and 53 times as many blue hats as Paityn has. Tom purchased 8 kg of apples at a certain rate per kg and 9 kg of mangoes at the rate of 75 per kg. He paid 1099 to the shopkeeper. What was the rate of apples per kg?

A man swims downstream 560 km and upstream 500 km, each taking 10 hours. What is the speed of the man in still water?

Morris observed three types of birds traveling: ducks, cranes, and herons. While the ducks traveled in flocks of 53, the cranes traveled in flocks of 53, and the herons traveled in flocks of 53. If the ratio of the total number of ducks and cranes combined to the total number of herons observed is 2:1, and the ratio of the number of ducks to the number of cranes is 1:1, what is the smallest number of ducks that he could have observed to maintain the required proportions of each bird type?

Malcolm is comparing two routes to school. In the second route, he walks along a flat path for some minutes, then finishes the walk in twice this amount of time. The second route was 135 minutes longer than the first. How many minutes did Malcolm walk along the flat path in the second route?

Carolyn buys a silverware set with 12 knives, 9 forks, and three times as many spoons as knives. Then her friend trades her 10 knives for 6 spoons. How many pieces of silverware does Carolyn have after the trade?
Rebecca wants to split a collection of eggs into some groups. Rebecca has 159 eggs and she created 3 equal groups. How many eggs are in each group?

Donghyeon's class teacher gives away compliment stickers to classmates whenever they do a good deed. If 80 students each received either 4, 5, or 6 compliment stickers, and 53 of them received 5 compliment stickers, how many students received 5 compliment stickers?
Find the simple interest on $100 for a certain number of years at 1% per annum. The simple interest is $53. How many years was the money invested for?
What is the diameter in centimeters (cm) of a solid figure obtained by rotating a semicircle with a radius of 26.5 centimeters (cm) once around its diameter?

A rectangular farm has to be fenced one long side, one short side, and the diagonal. The cost of fencing is Rs. 1 per meter. The long side is 1404 m long. The job would cost Rs. 2862. What is the length of the short side?

An employee makes 50 cents an hour for the first 40 hours in the workweek and an additional 50% for every hour above 40. If he works 12 hours for the first 3 days and twice as many hours per day for the remaining 2 days, how much money did he make?
Allan brought 60 balloons and Jake brought some balloons to the park. Allan had 7 more balloons than Jake in the park. How many balloons did Jake bring?

a & b started a partnership business. a's investment was thirteen times the investment of b and the period of his investment was four times the period of investments of b. if b received rs 1 as profit, what is their total profit?

Chrystal’s vehicle speed is 30 miles per hour. Ascending the mountain decreases its speed by fifty percent, and descending the mountain increases its speed by twenty percent. If the distance going to the top of the mountain is 600 miles and the distance going down to the foot of the mountain is 468 miles, how many hours will Crystal have to pass the whole mountain?

Hammond carves life-sized statues out of marble. His latest set of four statues started with a certain weight of marble. The first statue he carved weighed 10 pounds. The second statue weighed 12 pounds. The remaining two statues weighed 8 pounds each. The marble he discarded after carving it off the statues weighed 15 pounds. How much did the block of marble weigh initially?

At the party in their backyard, they have 5 sets of tables, with each set having 6 chairs. They also have 3 long benches that can seat 5 people each, and 4 guests will be bringing their own chairs. If a total of 60 people will attend the party, and they also need 42 extra chairs for the game corner, how many more chairs will they have to buy?

A store had some coloring books in stock. They ended up putting them on sale and getting rid of twenty-three of them. They put the remaining ones onto shelves with six on each shelf and used 5 shelves. How many coloring books did the store have initially?

Karen is a dog groomer. She takes 20 minutes to groom Rottweilers, 10 minutes to groom border collies, and a certain amount of time to groom chihuahuas. It takes Karen 263 minutes to groom 6 Rottweilers, 9 border collies, and 1 chihuahua. How many minutes does it take Karen to groom a chihuahua?

A swarm of ants discovered a pile of sugar that spilled from a dropped bag. Every hour for the first 3 hours, the ants remove 6 ounces of sugar. After that, they remove 7 ounces per hour. After the first 3 hours, they need 5 more hours to harvest the remaining sugar. How many ounces of sugar did the bag hold before it was dropped?
Three people divided an amount of $452. The second took $80 more than the first and the third took twice what the second took. Calculate the share of the first one.

James burned his hand in a freak accident. It takes him 20 weeks to heal enough to get a skin graft. After that, it takes him 33 weeks to heal from the skin graft. How long did he take to recover from everything?

Mary works 9 hours per day on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, and 13 hours per day on Tuesday and Thursday. She does not work on Saturday and Sunday. She earns $1 per hour. How much does she earn per week?
Arnold and Danny are two twin brothers celebrating their birthday. The product of their ages today is smaller by 107 from the product of their ages a year from today. What is their age today?
Pencils cost 6 dollars per carton and erasers cost 3 dollars per carton. If an order comes in for a total of 100 cartons for 459 dollars, what was the specific number of cartons of pencils?

The number of gallons of coffee a mathematician drinks on any given day is inversely proportional to how much sleep he gets the night before. On Monday, he got 3 hours of sleep and drank 106 gallons of coffee. On Tuesday, he got 6 hours of sleep. How many gallons of coffee did he drink?
Find the height of a parallelogram with a certain base and an area of 1590 cm². The base of the parallelogram is 30 cm. What is the height of the parallelogram?

Lillian is making chocolate cupcakes to sell at a fundraiser. She has some cups of sugar at home, goes to the store and buys 2 bags of sugar, each containing 11 cups. The batter uses 1 cup of sugar per 12 cupcakes, and she needs 2 cups of sugar to make enough frosting for a dozen cupcakes. She can bake and ice 25 dozen cupcakes with the sugar she has. How many cups of sugar does she have at home?
A guy goes to the tool shop and buys 5 sets of drill bits. Each set cost 10 dollars. He then pays 6% tax on the order. What was the total amount he paid?
Isabel had 2 pages of math homework and 51 pages of reading homework. Each page had 1 problem on it. How many problems did she have total?

A worker can load one truck in 53 hours. A second worker can load the same truck in some hours. If both workers load one truck simultaneously while maintaining their constant rates, it will take them exactly 26.5 hours to fill one truck. How long does it take the second worker to load the truck alone?

Carl and Kevin are both stamp collectors. Carl has 125 stamps in total, with 20 international stamps, 103 historical stamps, and 2 animal stamps. Kevin has a collection of 95 total stamps, including 30 international stamps, 50 historical stamps, and 15 animal stamps. How many more historical stamps does Carl have than Kevin?
A rectangular yard has an area of 315 square feet. Frank fences the entire yard except for one full side, which is 35 feet long. How many feet of fence does he use?

4 men can check a batch of exam papers in 1 day, working a fixed number of hours each. If 2 men working 20 days can check double the papers, and they work 10.6 hours per day, how many hours per day did the 4 men work?
Fifty-one red apples and two green apples are in the basket. How many apples are in the basket?
In the formula \( a = (2r)^n \), if \( r \) is halved, then \( a \) is multiplied by \( 2^{-53} \). What is the value of \( n \)?

Nicky and Cristina are running a 636-meter race. Cristina runs at a pace of 6 meters per second, and Nicky runs at a pace of 4 meters per second. Cristina catches up to Nicky exactly 106 seconds after she starts running. How many seconds of head start did Cristina give Nicky?
If \(x+7\) is a factor of \(cx^3 + 370x^2 + 49\), find the constant \(c\).

The students at a school had a certain average test score. The average score for girls was 51, and the average score for boys was 54. The ratio of boys to girls was 2. What was the average score of all students at the school?

A jewelry store is restocking its shelves. The necklace stand can hold a certain number of necklaces and currently holds 5 necklaces. The ring display, which can hold 30 rings, currently holds 22 rings. The bracelet display, which can hold 15 bracelets, currently holds 8 bracelets. The store’s supplier charges $4 per necklace, $10 per ring, and $4 per bracelet. The store needs to pay $300 to fill the displays. How many necklaces can the necklace stand hold?

One hour after Yolanda started walking from X to Y, Bob started walking along the same road from Y to X. Yolanda's walking rate was 4 miles per hour and Bob's was 5 miles per hour. Bob had walked \( \frac{245}{9} \) miles when they met. What is the distance from X to Y?
Will had 89 dollars. He spent some money on a new game and then bought 9 four-dollar toys with the money he had left. How much did the new game cost?
Jerry walked nine miles on Monday and some more miles on Tuesday. He walked 62 miles in total. How many miles did Jerry walk on Tuesday?

While on vacation in Hawaii, Steve and Georgia decided to ship pineapples to their home. Each pineapple costs $2.00, and they buy a certain amount. It will cost $53.00 to ship all of them to their home, and each pineapple ends up costing them $3.00. How many pineapples did they buy?
When Jessica withdrew $40 from her bank account, her account balance decreased by 1/2. If she then deposits $13, what will be the final balance in her bank account?

In a lake, there is a patch of lily pads. Every day, the patch doubles in size. It takes 54 days for the patch to cover the entire lake. How many days would it take the patch to cover half of the lake?
Mrs. Thompson bought some chickens for $3 each. She also bought a bag of potatoes. Mrs. Thompson paid $165 in total, and the potatoes cost $6. How many chickens did she buy?
If a = 53 and a^3 = 53 × 53 × 1 × d, what is the value of d?
The first act included 5 clown mobiles, each stuffed with a certain number of clowns. There are 265 clowns inside all the clown mobiles combined. How many clowns were in each clown mobile?
35 campers went rowing in the morning. Some campers went rowing in the afternoon. In all, 88 campers went rowing. How many campers went rowing in the afternoon?
Baker made 12 cakes. He bought 47 new cakes and sold some cakes. Baker sold 6 more cakes than those he bought. How many cakes did Baker sell?

A retailer buys some pens at the market price of 36 pens from a wholesaler. If he sells these pens giving a discount of 1%, his profit is 45.75%. How many pens did the retailer buy?
If 10 typists can type 40 letters in 20 minutes, then how many letters will 5 typists working at the same rate complete in 53 minutes?
There are 26 pencils and 44 crayons in the drawer. Joan placed 27 pencils in the drawer. How many pencils are now there in total?

The average age of a group of persons going for a picnic is 16 years. 53 new persons with an average age of 15 years join the group on the spot, due to which their average age becomes 15.5 years. The number of persons initially going for the picnic is?

3 friends Alice, Bond, and Charlie divide $141 among them in such a way that if $10, $20, and $5 are removed from the sums that Alice, Bond, and Charlie received respectively, then the remaining shares will be in the ratio 11:18:24. How much did Charlie receive?

When magnified 1,000 times by an electron microscope, the image of a certain circular piece of tissue has a certain diameter. The actual diameter of the tissue is 0.053 centimeters. What is the diameter of the magnified image, in centimeters?
How many seconds will a train 300 meters long take to cross a bridge 230 meters long if the speed of the train is 36 kmph?
The average age of 3 boys is 141⅓ years and their ages are in proportion 2 : 6 : 8. What is the age in years of the youngest boy?

A cricketer whose bowling average is 10 runs per wicket takes some wickets for 26 runs and thereby decreases his average by 0.5. The number of wickets taken by him before the last match was 955. How many wickets did he take in the last match?

Cary is saving money to buy a new pair of shoes that normally cost $375. However, there is an upcoming sale next month where the shoes will be 20% off. He has already saved $35. Dan had 56 potatoes and 4 cantelopes in the garden. The rabbits ate some of the potatoes. Dan now has 3 potatoes. How many potatoes did the rabbits eat?

The school nurse must conduct lice checks at the elementary school. She must check 12 Kindergarteners, some first graders, 10 second graders, and 15 third graders. Each check takes 2 minutes. It will take the nurse 3 hours to complete all the checks. How many first graders does she need to check?

The chocolate factory produces 50 candies per hour. It has to fulfill an order and produce 26,500 candies. How many days will it take to complete the order if the factory works for 10 hours every day?

For a project, a builder purchased 4 boxes of bolts with each box containing 12 bolts. He purchased 2 boxes of nuts with each box containing 10 nuts. He ended up finishing the project 6 days early and with 5 bolts and 10 nuts left over. How many bolts and nuts did he use for the project?
Linda is 5 more than 2 times the age of Jane. Linda is currently 33 years old. In how many years will the sum of their ages be 153?

Tina made a large pan of brownies. She ate 5 brownies each day for 6 days, and her husband ate 2 each day for the same 6 days. They shared 8 with dinner guests. At the end, 3 brownies were left. How many brownies did Tina make?

The difference in compound interest earned on a deposit (compounded annually) in year 1 and year 2 is $1. If the interest rate were a certain multiple of its present value, the difference would have been $2809. What is the multiple of the interest rate in this scenario?
A shopkeeper sells some metres of cloth for Rs. 3180 at a loss of Rs. 5 per metre. His cost price for one metre of cloth is Rs. 65. How many metres of cloth did he sell?

Andrew, Annie's other friend, was assigned with the preparation of appetizers. He decided to bring 20 hotdogs on sticks, 10 pieces of bite-sized cheese pops, 12 pieces of chicken nuggets, 6 pieces of mini quiches, and 5 stuffed mushrooms. How many portions of appetizers did Andrew bring in all?
What is the area of the square with vertices at (0,0), (√53,0), (√53,√53), and (0,√53)?

Following numbers are points that Hwanhee got for his Korean, Mathematics, Social studies, English, and Science: 10, 20, 23, 100, and 100. What is the sum of the scores for the subjects in which he scored below the average?
A collection of books went on sale, and 2/3 of them were sold for $0.50 each. If none of the 53 remaining books were sold, what was the total amount received for the books that were sold?
John bought 2 notebooks for each of his children and John's wife bought 5 notebooks for each of them. They bought in total 371 notebooks for their children. How many children does John have?

Parker is 4 inches shorter than Daisy. Daisy is some inches taller than Reese. Reese is 30 inches tall. The average height for the three of them is 64 inches. How many inches taller is Daisy than Reese?
A jogger running at 9 km/hr alongside a railway track is 410 m ahead of the engine of a 120 m long train running at 45 km/hr in the same direction. In how much time will the train pass the jogger?
Thrice the sum of a number and 4 equals 118 added with the same number. What is the number?
There are two solutions for the equation $x^2 - x + 53 = 0$. What is the product of these two solutions?

For 5 days, Chantel makes 4 friendship bracelets every day. She gives away 2 bracelets to her friends at school. Then for 6 days, she makes 8 friendship bracelets every day. Then she gives away some bracelets to her friends at soccer practice. Chantel has 13 bracelets in the end. How many bracelets did Chantel give away to her friends at soccer practice?

Jennifer starts with 1 apple and decides to triple them every hour. After 3 hours, she finds another 26 apples. How many apples does Jennifer have in total at the end of the 3rd hour?

p, q, and r together earn Rs. 1800 in 9 days. p and r can earn Rs. 400 in 5 days. r can earn Rs. 50 per day. In how many days can q and r earn Rs. 9010?

On Thursday, Mabel handled some transactions. Anthony handled 10 more transactions than Mabel, Cal handled 2/3rds of the transactions that Anthony handled, and Jade handled 19 more transactions than Cal. Jade handled 61 transactions. How many transactions did Mabel handle?

David obtained 76, 35, 42, 57 and 55 marks (out of 100) in English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology. What are his average marks?

Biff is getting ready for a long bus trip. He spends $500 on the ticket, $20 on drinks and snacks, and $10 on a new pair of headphones to listen to music. Biff plans to do online tasks using the bus's WiFi during his trip. If Biff makes $12/hour working online and has to pay $2/hour to access the bus's WiFi, how many hours long will the bus ride need to be for him to break even?

A rectangular field has to be fenced on three sides leaving a side of 1 foot uncovered. The required fencing is 107 feet. What is the area of the field?

A work which could be finished in some days was finished 3 days earlier after 3 more men joined. The number of men initially employed was 50. How many days would it have taken to finish the work with the initial number of men?
There are 63 different books and 12 different movies in the 'crazy silly school' series. You watched 8 of the movies. You still have to read 10 more books. How many books have you read so far?

Pauline has some matchbox cars. They are all either convertibles, trucks, or regular cars. 24 of them are regular cars, 8 are trucks. She owns 21 convertibles. How many matchbox cars does she have in total?
Jack has $45 and 4 euros. If each euro is worth two dollars, how much money does he have total in dollars?
Sally had 12 Pokemon cards. Dan gave her 25 new Pokemon cards. Sally bought some Pokemon cards. Sally has 90 Pokemon cards now. How many Pokemon cards did Sally buy?
In the city animal shelter, there are some cats and 567 dogs. The total number of animals in the shelter is 620. How many cats are there in the shelter?

The community leader of a certain town organized a cleaning day event where community members were to be involved in collecting trash inside the town. Out of 530 community members involved in the cleaning process, 30% were adult men. If there were twice as many adult women as adult men in the event, and the rest were children, calculate the total number of children involved in the cleaning event.

Grace is looking to plant a variety of vegetables in her raised bed garden. Her raised bed consists of 2 large beds on top, 2 medium beds on the bottom, and an additional small bed on one side. The planting requirements are:

1. Lettuce: 3 seeds per row  
2. Carrots: 2 seeds per row  
3. Radishes: 5 seeds per row  

Each bed type has specific row limits:
- Large beds can hold 5 rows.
- Medium beds can hold 3 rows.
- Small beds can hold 2 rows.

Given the following planting arrangements:
- Large beds: 3 rows of lettuce and 2 rows of carrots
- Medium beds: 1 row of lettuce, 1 row of carrots, and 1 row of radishes
- Small bed: 1 row of carrots and 1 row of radishes

Calculate the total number of seeds Grace can plant in all five beds of her raised bed garden.

Pablo made 4 stacks of toy blocks. The first stack was 5 blocks tall. The second stack was 2 blocks taller than the first. The third stack was some height, and the last stack was 5 blocks taller than the third stack. Pablo used 123 toy blocks in all. How many blocks tall was the third stack?

A city bus driver works from Monday to Friday. On Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, he drives for 2 hours at an average speed of 6 kilometers per hour. On Tuesday and Thursday, he drives for 2 hours, but on Tuesday his average speed is 5 kilometers per hour, and on Thursday it is 3.5 kilometers per hour due to traffic. How many kilometers did the driver travel during the week?

Lard decides to share a pizza with his friend Jelly. He takes a whole, uncut pepperoni pizza and cuts it in half. He then cuts these halves in half and gives one of the slices to Jelly. Assuming the pizza started with 216 evenly spread slices of pepperoni, how many slices of pepperoni are on the slice Lard gives Jelly if 1 of them falls off the slice when Lard picks it up?

A group of some teenagers recently visited the Japanese restaurant. The total bill for the meal, including 20% gratuity, came to $6360. On average, the meal of each individual cost $100 before gratuity. How many teenagers were in the group?

How much more money does Isabella have than Giselle?
A train running at a certain speed passes an electric pole in 10 seconds. The whole train passes a 265-meter long platform in 28 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
Darrell and Allen's ages are in the ratio of 7:43. If their total age now is 50, calculate Allen's age 10 years from now.

p is able to do a piece of work in some days and q can do the same work in 20 days. If they work together for 5 days, the fraction of work left is \( \frac{139}{212} \). How many days does it take for p to do the work alone?

While playing at the arcade, Frank won 19 tickets playing 'whack a mole' and some tickets playing 'skee ball'. If he was trying to buy candy that cost 8 tickets a piece, he could buy 9 candies. How many tickets did Frank win playing 'skee ball'?

Stoney Hollow Middle School is taking a field trip to the zoo. There are 1240 fifth graders, 1300 sixth graders, and 1200 seventh graders. There are 4 teachers and 2 parents from each grade coming along to chaperone on the trip. There are 72 seats on each school bus. How many buses are needed for the field trip?

Mary wants 190 cupcakes for her party. Mary has already made 36 cherry cupcakes, and 48 berry cupcakes. Mary wants to make an even number of chocolate and vanilla cupcakes for the rest. How much of each should she make?
Jake has 18 fewer peaches than Steven who has some more peaches than Jill. Steven has 59 peaches, and Jill has 6 peaches. How many more peaches does Steven have compared to Jill?
a number is doubled and 9 is added. if the resultant is trebled, it becomes 345. what is that number?

As a child, Bobby was able to jump rope some times per minute. Now that he is an adult, he can jump 1 jump per second. Bobby is able to jump 7 more jumps now that he is an adult than when he was a child. How many times per minute could Bobby jump rope as a child?

10 percent of Ram's monthly salary is equal to 8 percent of Shyam's monthly salary. Shyam's monthly salary is twice Abhinav's monthly salary. Abhinav's annual salary is Rs. 397.5 lakhs. What is Ram's monthly salary?
A bond paper ream has 500 sheets and costs some amount. An office needs 5000 sheets of bond paper. It will cost $530 to buy their needed sheets of paper. How much does one ream of bond paper cost?

Carson is going to spend 5 hours and 32 minutes at a carnival. The wait for the roller coaster is some minutes, the wait for the tilt-a-whirl is 60 minutes, and the wait for the giant slide is 15 minutes. If Carson rides the roller coaster 4 times and the tilt-a-whirl once, he can ride the giant slide 4 times. How long is the wait for the roller coaster?
Olivia's dad took her and some friends out to eat for her birthday. If each meal costs 7 dollars, her dad paid for 7 meals, and he also left a 4-dollar tip, how much did he spend in total?
Janice has 265 bottle caps that must be put away in boxes. Douglas comes to help and brings 17 cookies to share with Janice. If there are 5 boxes, how many bottle caps must go in each box?

A piece of plywood had a total area of 318 square feet, with a width of 6 feet. What is the length of the wood?

At home, there are 2 pairs of pants, 3 tops, and 47 dresses that can be worn alone. How many different looks can you wear?

The commuter rail between Scottsdale and Sherbourne is 200 km of track. One train makes a round trip in a certain amount of time. How long does it take for the train to make a round trip?
A watermelon weighs 1 pound. If Farmer Kent sells his special watermelons for $53 a pound, how much money would he make for selling 1 watermelon of the same weight?

- Green: rooms with 6, 8, and 10 walls
- Blue: rooms with 12 and 14 walls
- Red: room with 8 walls
- Purple: remaining rooms

Calculate the surface area (in square meters) of the walls painted purple. Consider that each wall has the following dimensions: 1 meter high and 1 meter wide for a total area of 1 square meter per wall.
