Ned opens a left-handed store. He sells left-handed mice. They cost 30% more than normal mice. If normal mice cost $10 and he makes $689 in a week, how many mice does he sell that week?

Two bullet trains of equal lengths take 10 seconds and 53 seconds respectively to cross a telegraph post. The length of each bullet train is 1060 meters. They cross each other traveling in opposite directions in 1060/63 seconds. How long does it take for the second bullet train to cross the telegraph post?
In fourth grade, there were 31 students at the start of the year. During the year, 5 students left and 27 new students came to school. How many students were in fourth grade at the end of the year?
Jesse's room is 19 feet wide and 72 feet long. How much longer is her room than it is wide?
If a - b = 5 and a² + b² = 131, find the value of ab.
A batsman in his 25th innings makes a score of 125 and thereby increases his average by 3 runs. What is his average after the 25th innings if he had never been 'not out'?

A 530-meter long train crosses a platform in 60 seconds while it crosses a signal pole in some time. The length of the platform is 70 meters. How long does it take for the train to cross the signal pole?
A rectangular garden is 12 m long and 5 m wide. A path of uniform width is built around it, and the total area including the path is 113 m². What is the area of the path alone?

Worker A takes 10 hours to do a job, and Worker B takes 15 hours to do the same job. If they work together on 8 complete jobs and then work together for 5 more hours on a 9th job, how many total hours do they work?

Pearl wants to order monogrammed Christmas stockings for each of her grandchildren and her own 4 children. The stockings are $20.00 each and currently 10% off. The monogramming will cost $5.00 per stocking. The stockings cost $1311. How many grandchildren does Pearl have?

Michael’s largest watermelon weighs some pounds. His neighbor, Clay, grew a watermelon three times that size. Their mutual friend, John, grew a watermelon that was half the size of Clay’s and weighed 79.5 pounds. How big was Michael's watermelon?
A goods train runs at a speed of 72 kmph and crosses a 247 m long platform in 15 seconds. What is the length of the goods train?
The perimeter of a triangle is some length and the inradius of the triangle is 1.5 cm. The area of the triangle is 39.75 cm². What is the perimeter of the triangle?

Wilson decides to go sledding on some nearby hills. On the 2 tall hills, he sleds down them a certain number of times each and on the 3 small hills, he sled down them three times as often as he sleds down the tall hills. He sled down the hills 583 times. How many times did he sled down each tall hill?

Janet was playing a video game and had some lives. In a hard part of the game, she lost 16 lives. If she got 32 more lives in the next level, she would have 69 lives. How many lives did Janet have initially?

A farmer has an apple orchard consisting of Fuji and Gala apple trees. Due to some weather conditions, a certain percentage of his trees cross-pollinated. The number of his trees that are pure Fuji plus the cross-pollinated ones totals 221, while 62 of all his trees are pure Fuji. There are 79 pure Gala trees. What percentage of his trees cross-pollinated?

Two cars are traveling in the same direction along the same route. The red car travels at a constant speed of 40 miles per hour, and the black car is traveling at a certain speed. If the red car is 39 miles ahead of the black car, it will take the black car 3 hours to overtake the red car. What is the speed of the black car?

A mad scientist created a shrink ray device that, when used on anything, would cause it to shrink by 50%. The scientist zapped his wife, who was carrying a tray containing some cups filled with coffee. Each coffee cup held 8 ounces of fluid before being zapped. After his wife and the cups filled with coffee were shrink zapped, there were 212 ounces of coffee remaining. How many cups of coffee were on the tray?
Josh went to the shopping center. He bought some films and 1 book. He also bought 1 CD. Each film cost $5, each book cost $4 and each CD cost $3. Josh spent $272 in all. How many films did he buy?
A figure has a perimeter of 371 centimeters (cm) and a side length of 7 centimeters (cm), and all sides are the same length. How many sides are there in total?

Ms. Hatcher teaches 2 third-graders and a number of fourth-graders. Her co-teacher asked her to substitute for her fifth-grade class that has half as many students as the number of third-graders. Ms. Hatcher taught 109 students for the day. What is the ratio of the number of fourth-graders to the number of third-graders?
Find the number of moles of Magnesium sulfate formed on combining 53 moles of Magnesium and 100 moles of Sulfuric acid, keeping in mind the limiting reactant concept.

In a class of 87 students, 20 students like to play basketball, 18 like to play cricket, and 12 like to play football. It's known that 8 students like both basketball and cricket, 6 students like both cricket and football, and 5 students like both football and basketball. There are 3 students who like to play all three sports. How many students do not like to play either of these three sports?
Serenity bought some pairs of shoes during the Thanksgiving sale. She now has a total of 106 new shoes. How many pairs of shoes did she buy?

In a field with dimensions of 12 m by 9 m, a pit 2 m long, 1 m wide, and with a certain depth is dug in one corner of the field, and the earth removed has been evenly spread over the remaining area of the field, causing a rise in the height of the field by 1 m. What is the depth of the pit?
In an examination, 24 students passed and 29 students failed. How many students appeared for the examination?
Joan has saved some quarters from washing cars and now she has 1325 cents. How many quarters has Joan saved?
If 15 students in a class average 45% on an exam and 10 students average 65% on the same exam, what is the average in percent for all 25 students?

In his first season at Best Hockey's team, Louie scored four goals in the last hockey match of this season. His brother has scored twice as many goals as Louie scored in the last match in each game he's played in each of the three seasons he's been on the team. Each season has a certain number of games. The brothers have scored a total of 1320 goals between them, with Louie scoring 44 goals in previous matches. How many games are in each season?

Mary is baking a cake. The recipe calls for some cups of sugar, 15 cups of flour, and 18 cups of salt. She already put in 12 cups of flour. She needs to add 2 more cups of sugar than cups of salt now. How many total cups of sugar, flour, and salt does the recipe call for?
The speed of a boat in still water is 20 km/hr. The distance travelled downstream in 30 minutes is 36.5 km. What is the rate of the current?

During a sale, the price of a pair of shoes is marked down 34.64% from the regular price. After the sale ends, the price goes back to the original price. What is the percent of increase to the nearest percent from the sale price back to the regular price for the shoes?
Jenny wants to read some books in the next 12 days. She reads 100 words per hour. Each book has 20 words. She should spend 53 minutes per day reading. How many books does she want to read?
One number is 3 less than twice another number. The sum of the 2 numbers is 81. What is the larger number?
A certain percentage of a number is 24 more than 50% of that number. The number is 800. What is the percentage?

Alex has 18 shirts, 12 pants, 17 sweaters, and some jeans to wash. The washing machine can wash 20 items per cycle and takes 45 minutes per cycle. It takes 3 hours and 45 minutes to wash all the clothes. How many jeans does Alex have?
There were 212 people at the school dance. Twenty-five percent were faculty and staff. Of the remaining attendees, two-thirds were girls. How many boys attended the school dance?

A salon has the same amount of customers every day. Each customer needs 1 can of hairspray during the styling and is also given 1 can of hairspray to take home. The salon also buys an extra 5 cans of hairspray each day to ensure there is never a shortage. How many cans of hairspray does the salon buy every day if they have 24 customers each day?
Anthony bought 63 bananas. He ate some of the bananas and has 10 bananas left now. How many bananas did he eat?
If a certain number times a equals 2809b and ab ≠ 0, the ratio of a to b is 53. What is the number?

Part of Stella's job is to restock the toilet paper in each of the 6 bathrooms at the bed and breakfast. She stocks 1 roll a day, every day of the week. She buys the toilet paper in bulk, and each pack contains 1 dozen rolls. After 15 weeks and 1 day, how many packs of toilet paper did Stella buy?
A pet supply store has 600 bags of dog food and 547 bags of cat food. There are _____ more bags of dog food than cat food.
The average weight of some oarsmen in a boat is increased by 2 kg when one of the crew, who weighs 40 kg, is replaced by a new man who weighs 146 kg. How many oarsmen are there in the boat?
A whole pizza was cut into 60 slices. Angeli and Marlon ate 3.5 slices each. How many slices of pizza are left?

Ava decides to go to a nearby animal farm that has a total of 60 animals. He is standing in a queue near the entry gate, from the gate he could only see legs of the animals in the farm and he counted the total number of legs to be 134. He already knows that there are only chickens and buffalos in this farm. From this information find the number of chickens.

On a Sunday morning, Josephine sold milk in the farm stall. She filled three containers with two liters each, two containers with 0.75 liters each, and a certain number of containers with 0.5 liters each. Josephine sold 34 liters of milk in total. How many containers did she fill with 0.5 liters each?

Jane is sewing sequins onto her trapeze artist costume. She sews 6 rows of 8 blue sequins each, 5 rows of 12 purple sequins each, and some rows of 6 green sequins each. She adds a total of 426 sequins. How many rows of green sequins does she sew?
Find the smallest positive integer exponent greater than 50 such that the last digit of 2 raised to that exponent is 2.

Robin drank fifteen bottles of water in the morning, twelve bottles in the afternoon, eighteen bottles in the evening, and eight bottles throughout the night. How many bottles of water did Robin drink in total?

A case of 12 rolls of paper towels sells for $5.64. The cost of one roll sold individually is $1. What is the percent of savings per roll for the 12-roll package over the cost of 12 rolls purchased individually?
Rachel bought 5 music albums online, each with 10 songs, and then bought 3 additional individual songs. How many songs did she buy in total?
Jack received 4 emails in the morning and some more in the afternoon. If he received a total of 57 emails in the day, how many emails did Jack receive in the afternoon?

Lara is a contestant on a fun game show where she needs to navigate an inflated bouncy house obstacle course. First she needs to carry a backpack full of treasure through the obstacle course and set it down on the other side, which she does in 20 seconds. Second, she needs to crank open the door to the obstacle course so she can go back through, which takes her 15 seconds. After she gets through the door she traverses the obstacle course again and makes it out faster without the backpack, in 18 seconds. How many seconds total does it take her to complete the obstacle course?

Flies are Betty's frog's favorite food. Every day the frog eats 5 flies. Betty puts the flies she finds in a bottle. In the morning Betty catches 5 flies inside a bottle, and in the afternoon she catches some more, but when she removes the lid, one escapes. Betty wants to gather the whole 12 days' food for her frog. She needs 3 more flies. How many flies did Betty catch in the afternoon before one escaped?

A printer decides to use two sizes of type for an article. Using the larger type, a printed page contains 10 words. Using smaller type, a page contains 11 words. The article is allotted 5 full pages in a magazine, and there must be 3 pages in smaller type. How many words are in the article?
How many paving stones, each measuring 2 m by 4 m, are required to pave a rectangular courtyard 106 m long and 4 m wide?
Calvin weighed 313 pounds to start, lost the same amount each month for 3 months, and ended at 154 pounds. How many pounds did he lose each month?

Harry is traveling home on the bus. He has already been sat on the bus for 7 minutes, and he knows the rest of the journey will take some time. A train running at a certain speed crosses a pole in 7 seconds. The length of the train is 1855/18 meters. What is the speed of the train in km/hr?

Matt climbs 6 feet/minute, Jason climbs at a certain speed. After 2 minutes, Jason is 94 feet higher than Matt. How many feet per minute can Jason climb?

Faye had 60 apps on her phone, 25 of them were gaming apps and the rest were utility apps. To free up some space, she decided to delete some apps but wanted to keep at least one app from each category. If she deleted 4 gaming apps and 3 utility apps, how many apps did she have left on her phone?

Last year at Newberg's airport, 42 passengers landed on time. Unfortunately, 11 passengers landed late. How many passengers landed in Newberg last year in total?

A warehouse store sells cartons of gum. Each carton contains 1 pack of gum, and there is 1 stick of gum in each pack. Each full brown box contains 7 cartons of gum. There are 7 full brown boxes and 2 brown boxes that contain only 2 cartons each. How many sticks of gum are there in all the brown boxes?

Amy had some candy. She gave her friend fifty-eight pieces and had five left. What's the difference between the pieces of candy Amy gave away and the left?
If Jake loses 33 pounds, he will weigh twice as much as his sister. Together they now weigh 63 pounds. What is Jake's present weight, in pounds?
A rectangular prism has length 2 inches and height 1 inch. Its surface area is 322 square inches. What is the width?

In a class of some students, 12 enrolled for both English and German. 22 enrolled for German. If the students of the class enrolled for at least one of the two subjects, then there are 31 students who enrolled for only English and not German. How many students are there in the class?
Solve the given equation \(53^y = x^{12}\), where \(y = 12\). What is the value of \(x\)?

There are 72 different books and 19 different movies in the 'crazy silly school' series. If you read 11 of the books and watched 6 of the movies, how many more books than movies are there in the 'crazy silly school' series?

While sorting some buttons, Malia put 5 buttons in the first box, 29 buttons in the second box, some buttons in the third box, 77 buttons in the fourth box, and 101 buttons in the fifth box. If this pattern continues, Malia will put 125 buttons in the sixth box. How many buttons did Malia put in the third box?
A train 255 meters long is traveling at a certain speed and can cross a bridge in 36 seconds. The bridge is 275 meters long. What is the speed of the train in km/hr?

A man has some one-rupee notes, 5-rupee notes, and 10-rupee notes. The number of 10-rupee notes is 3 more than the number of 5-rupee notes, and the number of 1-rupee notes is 5 more than the number of 10-rupee notes. If the total value of the money is Rs. 262, what is the total number of notes he has?

The average weight of A, B, and C is 50 kg. If D joins the group, the average weight of the group remains 50 kg. If another man E, who weighs 32 kg more than D, replaces A, then the average of B, C, D, and E becomes some kg. What is the new average weight of the group if the weight of A is 70 kg?

Rashmi walks to her bus stop at 5 kmph and reaches there late by a certain number of minutes. On the next day, she increases her speed to 6 kmph and reaches the bus stop the same number of minutes early. The bus stop is 53 km away. How many minutes was she late on the first day?

Carolyn is trimming a dress with lace around the cuffs, waist, hem, and neckline. The hem is 300 cm long, the waist is 94 cm, and the neck will have 5 ruffles that each use 20 cm of lace. If lace costs $6/m, and Carolyn spends $36 on lace, how long is each cuff?

Two stations A and B are 312 km apart on a straight line. One train starts from A at 7 a.m. and travels towards B at 20 kmph. Another train starts from B at 8 a.m. and travels towards A at a certain speed. They meet at 12 p.m. What is the speed of the second train?

Darius has some buckets of water. One contains 10 ounces, one contains 13 ounces, one contains 7 ounces, one contains 15 ounces, and one contains 8 ounces. He pours the ten-ounce bucket into a bigger bucket, along with the thirteen-ounce bucket. The total in the bigger bucket is now 23 ounces. He pours the remaining three buckets into a second large bucket. The second large bucket contains 30 ounces. How many ounces of water does Darius have in total across all five buckets?

She worked at her old company for some months earning $1000 per month, and she's now earning 20% more in the new company. She has earned a total of $122,600 in both companies in the period she's worked for them. How many months did she work for her old company?

At a special sale, 100 tickets can be purchased for the price of some tickets. If 100 tickets are purchased at the sale, the amount saved will be 47% of the original price of the 100 tickets. For how many tickets' price can 100 tickets be purchased at the sale?

A group of researchers are studying a colony of penguins. Their results show that the size doubled in the first year they watched the colony, then tripled in the next year. This year, however, harsh conditions meant the colony only gained 759 penguins. The colony has 1077 penguins in it now. Each penguin eats one fish every day. How many fish did the whole colony catch per day to eat at the beginning of the first year?
One dress requires 5.5 yards of fabric. Amare needs to make 4 dresses for the wedding and she has 13 feet of fabric. How many feet of fabric does Amare still need for the dresses?

In a certain city, 50 percent of the registered voters are Democrats and the rest are Republicans. In a mayoral race, 61 percent of the registered voters who are Democrats and some percent of the registered voters who are Republicans are expected to vote for candidate A. Candidate A is expected to receive 57 percent of the registered voters' votes. What percent of the registered voters who are Republicans are expected to vote for candidate A?
A waiter had 68 customers. After some left, the difference between the number before and after leaving is 15. How many customers were left?

If he is supposed to leave $300 in notes as well as all the coins in the till and turn the rest in to the main office, how much money will he be handing in?
If (x + 3)^2 / (73x - 411) = 1, what is the difference between the two possible values of x?
When 1/10 of 530 is subtracted from 1/5 of 530, what is the difference?

A department store displays a 20% discount on all fixtures. A 25 cm high bedside lamp has a new price of $42.40 after the discount. What was the original price of the bedside lamp?

What is the area of the rectangular region in square feet?
If 4 men can colour 53 m long cloth in 2 days, then 8 men can colour a certain length of cloth in 1 day. What is the length of the cloth that the 8 men are colouring?

The farm entrance fee for students costs a certain amount and $6 for adults. The school will pay $1879 for the farm entrance in all. How much does the farm entrance fee cost for students?

Tony decided to rent a small cottage. The master bedroom and bath totaled 700 sq ft. The 2 guest bedrooms have a certain area each. And the kitchen, guest bath and living area totaled 694 sq ft. Tony spends $3,000 a month on rent, and he is spending $2 per sq ft of house. What is the area of each guest bedroom?

17 is subtracted from and 29 added to this number. What number is required for the result of this to be 65?
My 2 cats had 26 female kittens and 25 male kittens. How many cats do I have in total?

Two trains are moving in the same direction at 162 kmph and 18 kmph. The faster train with a length of 2120 meters crosses a man in the slower train in some time. How long does it take for the faster train to cross the man in the slower train?

Company C sells a line of 4 products with an average retail price of $20. If none of these products sells for less than $3, and exactly 1 of the products sells for less than $12, what is the greatest possible selling price of the most expensive product?

Gondor is a technician who earns $10 from repairing a phone and $20 from repairing a laptop. He repaired 3 phones last Monday, 5 phones last Tuesday, and 8 laptops on Wednesday. He earned $1300 in total for the week. How many laptops did he repair last Thursday?

A captain steers his ship 5 miles north on the first day of their journey. On the second day, he sails to the east for a certain multiple of the distance he covered on the first day. What is the ratio of the distance the ship traveled east on the second day to the distance it traveled north on the first day?

The length of the bridge, which a train 322 m long and traveling at 45 km/hr can cross in 30 sec, is?

A local school is holding a food drive. Mark brings in 4 times as many cans as Jaydon. Jaydon brings in 53 more than twice the amount of cans that Rachel brought in. There are 320 cans total. How many more cans did Jaydon bring in compared to twice the amount of cans Rachel brought in?

Paul was collecting cans for recycling. On Saturday he filled 3 bags, and on Sunday he filled 2 more bags. If each bag on Saturday had 11 cans in it, and each bag on Sunday had 10 cans in it, he picked up _____ cans in total.
Isabella's hair is 47 inches long. By the end of the year her hair is some inches long. She grew 6 inches of hair. How long was Isabella's hair at the end of the year?

Find the area of a trapezium whose parallel sides are some length and 18 cm long, and the distance between them is 20 cm. The area of the trapezium is 710 square centimeters. What is the length of the other parallel side?

The distance from city A to city B is 2650 miles. While driving from city A to city B, Cara drives at a constant speed of 50 miles per hour. Dan leaves city A 3 hours after Cara. What is the minimum constant speed in miles per hour that Dan must exceed in order to arrive in city B before Cara?

Janessa has a plan to give her brother Dexter his first collection of baseball cards. She currently has 4 cards in addition to the 13 that her father gave her. She ordered a collection of 60 cards from eBay. After inspecting the cards she found 4 cards are in bad shape and decides to throw them away. Janessa ended up giving Dexter some cards. Janessa kept 20 cards for herself. How many cards did she give to Dexter?

How many cups of juice were drunk during the party?

Amit and Ananthu can do a work in 5 days and 125 days respectively. Amit started the work and left after 3 days. Ananthu took over and completed the work. In how many days was the total work completed?
James buys some notebooks with 50 pages each. He pays $53 and each page costs 2 cents. How many notebooks did he buy?
Tim sleeps 7 hours per day on 5 days a week, and 9 hours per day on the other 2 days. How many total hours does he sleep in a week?

A farmer is buying feed for his horses. He buys a variety of hay, oats, carrots and sugar cubes. Since sugar cubes are a rare treat, he only buys two 1-pound boxes of them for the whole stable. He only wants enough carrots to feed the horses while the vegetables are fresh, so he buys four 12-pound bags. Hay is the main diet of his horses, so he buys forty 55-pound bales. I had to divide a number by 3, add 14, then multiply by 2, but I made a mistake by multiplying by 3, adding 14, then multiplying by 2 and got 253. How much is the original calculation?
There are 100 pencils in a box. Eric takes some pencils, and there are 47 pencils left. How many pencils did Eric take?

In a factory, each day the expected number of accidents is related to the number of overtime hours by a linear equation. On one day, there were some overtime hours logged and 8 accidents reported, and on another day, there were 21.2 overtime hours logged and 5 accidents. The expected number of accidents when no overtime hours are logged is 3. How many overtime hours were logged on the day with 8 accidents?
Sherry is making banana bread for a bake sale. She wants to make 106 loaves. Her recipe makes enough batter for 2 loaves. The recipe calls for 1 banana. How many bananas does Sherry need?
Jorge scored 21 goals playing soccer last season. This season he scored 32 goals. What is the total number of goals Jorge scored?
Allan brought some balloons and Jake brought seven balloons to the park. Allan and Jake had 60 balloons in the park. How many balloons did Allan bring?
After geometry class, Bill wants to count how many lines he drew. For each shape, he drew one line per side. If he drew 6 triangles, 5 squares, and 3 pentagons, how many lines did he draw?

If a bowl contains a total of 256 ounces of nuts, representing a mixture of both brands, and some ounces of the mixture are almonds, then 36 ounces of brand Q's deluxe mixed nuts are used. How many ounces of the mixture are almonds?

Car X began traveling at an average speed of 53 miles per hour. After 30 minutes, car Y began traveling at an average speed of 79.5 miles per hour. When both cars had traveled the same distance, both cars stopped. How many miles did car X travel from the time car Y began traveling until both cars stopped?
Fred had 60 dimes in his bank. His sister borrowed some of his dimes, and now Fred has 7 dimes left. How many dimes did his sister borrow?
Claire wants to make 2 cakes for her mother. She pays $65 for flour and uses $12 worth. How much money does she have left?
There are 10 gallons of water in Becky's fish tank. If Becky adds some gallons more, in all, there will be 63 gallons. How many gallons does Becky need to add?

The dimensions of a room are 12 feet * 11 feet * 2 feet. What is the cost of white washing the 4 walls of the room at Rs. 1 per square foot if there is one door of dimensions 5 feet * 3 feet and 3 windows of dimensions 4 feet * 2 feet each?
In a sports club with 62 members, 60 play badminton and 55 play tennis, and none play neither. How many members play both badminton and tennis?

In a family there are two cars. In a given week, the first car gets an average of 25 miles per gallon, and the second car gets some miles per gallon. A train that is 390 meters long is running at a certain speed. It will pass a bridge of 140 meters length in 36 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/hour?

Cody had a bag of marbles. Later he gave five to his brother. Now Cody has some marbles left. Initially, Cody had 58 marbles. How many marbles does Cody have now?

If it takes the police some minutes to inspect each vehicle and the probability that the police will find the transmitter within 3 hours is 1/265, how many minutes does it take for the police to inspect each vehicle?

A theater charges $12 for seats in the orchestra and a certain amount for seats in the balcony. On a certain night, a total of 370 tickets were sold for a total cost of $15,920. An investor can sell her Microtron stock for $36 per share and her Dynaco stock for $53 per share. She sells 17 shares altogether, some of each stock, at an average price per share of $40. She has sold 4 shares of Dynaco stock. What is the price per share of Dynaco stock?

A parking garage rents parking spaces for $13 per week or some amount per month. A person saves $40 in a year by renting by the month rather than by the week. How much does the garage charge per month for a parking space?

Kenny played some hours of basketball last week. He ran for twice as long as he played basketball, and he practiced on the trumpet for twice as long as he ran. Kenny practiced on the trumpet for 212 hours last week. How many hours did Kenny play basketball?

Lydia is planning a road trip with her family and is trying to plan a route. She has 106 liters of fuel and she will use all of this during her trip. The farmers reported that they harvest some sacks of apples from each of the 8 sections of the orchard daily. They harvest 424 sacks of apples every day. How many sacks of apples are harvested from each section daily?

In a classroom, there are blue chairs, green chairs, and white chairs. There are 10 blue chairs. The green chairs are 2 times as many as the blue chairs, and there are 7 fewer white chairs than the green and blue chairs combined. How many chairs are there in the classroom?

An Italian sausage is 38.95 centimeters long. How many pieces of sausage can be cut from the 38.95-centimeter piece of sausage if each piece is to be cut in alternating sizes of 3/5 of a centimeter and 7/8 of a centimeter?

A train crosses a signal pole in 9 seconds and crosses a platform in 27 seconds. The platform is 106 meters long. What is the length of the train?

If he completes the same number of questions every day and aims to complete 142 questions each day, how much time does he have to complete both projects?

In the first 10 overs of a cricket game, the run rate was only 3.2. What should be the run rate in the remaining 50 overs to reach the target of 2682 runs?

The treasurer of a football team must buy equipment for the four players of his team. Each piece of equipment consists of a $6.25 jersey, a $4.00 pair of shorts, and a pair of socks at $3.00. How much does all the equipment of all the players on the team cost?

The cost for 2 bats and 4 balls is $264. The cost for 1 bat and 6 balls is $276. There is also an 8% sales tax on all purchases. If someone were to buy an equal number of bats and balls, what is the maximum number of bats they can purchase if they have a budget of $5000, considering the discount and sales tax?

How many topping combinations does he have total?

Mary received $1000 more than Mike did. The profit made by their business in that year was $10053. What portion of the profit was divided equally for their efforts?

Mark got a 15% raise at his job. Before the raise, he earned 40 dollars per hour. He works 8 hours per day for 5 days per week. His old bills used to be 1292 dollars a week. He has decided to add a hundred dollar a week personal trainer, as well as subscribe to a weekly investment plan of 50 dollars. Additionally, Mark's city has decided to implement a progressive tax system. For the first 300 dollars earned per week, there is a tax rate of 10%. For earnings from 301 dollars to 1000 dollars a week, the tax rate is 15%. Any earnings above 1000 dollars a week are taxed at 25%. Taking into account the increased expenses and the new taxation rates, how much is left from Mark's salary each week after all his expenses and tax deductions have been accounted for?

Two trucks are at rest stops on opposite sides of the same highway. Driver A heads down the highway at 25 kilometers per hour. Exactly one hour later, Driver B starts toward Driver A at 15 kilometers per hour. When they meet, Driver A has driven 32 kilometers farther than Driver B. How far apart were the two trucks initially?

Jill works as a waitress at the local diner where she earns an hourly wage of $4.00 per hour and a standard tip rate of 15% of the cost of the orders she serves. She worked a certain number of 8-hour shifts this week and averaged $40 in orders per hour. Jill earned $4,240 this week. How many 8-hour shifts did she work this week?
$B$ and $C$ trisect $\overline{AD}$ and $M$ is the midpoint of $\overline{AD}$. $MC = \frac{53}{6}$. How many units are in the length of $\overline{AD}$?

Julieta went to the store to buy a backpack and three ring-binders for her school supplies. She knew the backpack was $50, and each ring-binder cost was $20. However, at the store, she found out that the price of a backpack had increased by some amount, and the price of a ring-binder had reduced by $2. Julieta spent a total of $157 at the store. How much did the price of the backpack increase?

Marlene wants to buy half a dozen shirts to avail of the sale. The regular price of a shirt is a certain amount and is now on sale at a 20% discount. Marlene will pay $254.40 for the shirts. What is the regular price of a shirt?
53 persons can repair a road in 12 days, working 15 hours a day. In how many days will 30 persons, working 6 hours a day, complete the work?
A rectangular piece of metal is 16 centimeters wide and has a certain length. Its perimeter is 138 centimeters. What is the length of the rectangular piece of metal?
The length of a room is 5.5 m and the width is 4 m. The cost of paving the floor by slabs is Rs. 1,166. What is the rate of paving the floor per sq. meter?

A furniture dealer purchased a desk for $795 and then set the selling price equal to the purchase price plus a markup that was 25% of the selling price. After keeping this desk in the showroom, the dealer decided to offer a 20% discount on the desk's marked price to attract more customers. If the dealer sold the desk after offering the discount, what was the amount of the dealer's gross profit from the purchase and the sale of the desk in this scenario?
Find the distance covered by a man walking for 53 minutes at a speed of 60 km/hr.
A certain ratio expressed as a percent equals 100%. If the first part of the ratio is 53, what is the second part of the ratio?
Carol collects 48 peanuts. Carol's father gives Carol 5 more. How many peanuts does Carol have in total?

A cargo ship carrying 4 kinds of items, doohickies, geegaws, widgets, and yamyams, arrives at the port. Each item weighs 3, 4, 25, and 5 pounds, respectively, and each item is weighed as it is unloaded. In the middle of the unloading process, 2 widgets and 1 doohickie have been unloaded. What is the sum of the individual weights of the unloaded items?
There are 43 dogs, some fish, and 34 cats at my farm. I have 130 pets at my farm. How many fish do I have at my farm?

Jancy had 100 currency notes in all, some of which are of Rs 70 denomination and the remaining of Rs 50 denomination. The total amount of all these currency notes was Rs 5940. How many notes of Rs 50 denomination did she have?
In what time will a train 2120 m long cross an electric pole, if its speed is 144 km/hr?

A man earns Rs 53 on the first day and spends Rs 51 on the second day, and earns the same amount on the third day and spends Rs 51 on the fourth day, and so on. On the 60th day, he will have Rs 60. How much does he earn on the first and third days?

The difference of two numbers is a certain value. On dividing the larger number by the smaller, we get 9 as quotient and 5 as remainder. The larger number is 59. What is the difference between the two numbers?

Ten fourth-graders each bought the same number of pizzas from Doc's Pizza, which has 6 pieces per pizza. The children are carrying a total of 3180 pieces of pizza. How many pizzas did each fourth-grader buy?
Dan picked 49 limes and Sara gave him 4 limes. Dan has _____ limes now.

The school band has 86 songs in their repertoire. The band played 10 songs in their first set and a certain number of songs in their second set. The band will play 3 songs for their encore. Assuming the band plays through their entire repertoire, they will play on average 10 songs in the third and fourth sets. How many songs did they play in the second set?
If 50% of 110 is greater than a percentage of a number by 2, and the number is 100, what is the percentage?

In a sample of 1000 high school students in which all students are either freshmen, sophomores, juniors, or seniors, there are 25 juniors and 15 seniors. There are 20 more freshmen than sophomores. What percentage of the students are not sophomores?
Megan had 500 files on her computer. She deleted 23 of them and put the rest into folders. Megan ended up with 9 folders. How many files were in each folder?

A rectangular tank needs to be coated with insulation. The tank has dimensions of some feet, 5 feet, and 2 feet. Each square foot of insulation costs $20. It will cost $15,240 to cover the surface of the tank with insulation. What is the length of the first dimension of the tank?
Tessa has 10 apples. Anita gave her some more apples. She needs 64 apples to make a pie and now needs 1 more apple to make a pie. How many apples did Anita give her?

A tank with a volume of 20 cubic feet has one inlet pipe and 2 outlet pipes. The inlet pipe fills water into the tank at a certain rate and the 2 outlet pipes empty it out at the rates of 33 cubic inches/min and 32 cubic inches/min respectively. If all 3 pipes are opened when the tank is full, it takes 2880 minutes to empty the tank. What is the rate at which the inlet pipe fills water into the tank in cubic inches/min? (1 foot = 12 inches)

A company has some employees. 29 employees drive to work. Of the rest, half take public transportation. There are 17 more employees who drive than take public transportation. How many employees does the company have?
What is the sum of the 5 smallest positive multiples of 3, plus 8?

Jerry needs to shingle 3 roofs. Each roof is made of two slanted rectangular sides measuring 20 feet by 40 feet. He needs a certain number of shingles to cover one square foot of roof. He needs a total of 254400 shingles. How many shingles does he need to cover one square foot of roof?

A factory uses robots to manufacture batteries. For each battery that is made, it takes a robot 6 minutes to gather the materials for the battery and 9 minutes to create the battery. The factory has some robots working on batteries at the same time. These robots can manufacture 1060 batteries in 5 hours. How many robots are working on batteries at the same time?
Taipei 101 in Taiwan is 881 feet tall. Suppose the first to 52nd floors have height each equal to 16.5 feet, and the 53rd floor is 23 feet high. How many floors are there in Taipei 101?

Cassie is trimming her pet's nails. She has two dogs and three parrots. Each dog has four nails on each foot, and each parrot has three claws on each leg, except for three parrots who each have an extra toe. How many nails does Cassie need to cut?
Among the sides of a regular 106-gon, how many pairs of sides are parallel to each other?
Maria bought 3 green towels and some white towels. If she gave her mother 34 of them, Maria ended up with 22 towels. How many white towels did Maria buy?
Sam found 182 seashells on the beach. He gave Joan 43 seashells, then gave Ali 27 seashells, and finally gave Lee 59 seashells. He has _____ many seashells now.

For the gala luncheon planning committee, Margaret wants to serve chicken salad sandwiches using mini croissants. She wants there to be enough food that each person on the committee can have 1 sandwich each. Mini croissants cost $0.50 each, and she will spend $26.50 on croissants. How many people are on the committee?

Excluding stoppages, the speed of a train is 53 kmph, and including stoppages, it is 34 kmph. The train stops for \( \frac{1140}{53} \) minutes per hour. What is the speed of the train excluding stoppages?

A tomato plant has 84 tomatoes. Jane picks 1/3 of that number for use in their house. After a week, she goes back and picks 1 more tomato, and the following week picks twice that number. What's the total number of fruits remaining on the tomato plant?

Sarah buys some pencils on Monday. Then she buys 18 more pencils on Tuesday. On Wednesday she buys triple the number of pencils she did on Tuesday. She has 125 pencils. How many pencils did she buy on Monday?

Carla is taking attendance for her sixth-grade class. She knows that 3 students are in the restroom, and one less than three times that number of students are absent. There are seven rows with six desks each that are all full. How many students does Carla teach, including the ones in and out of the classroom?
A compound has some Aluminium and 3 Iodine atoms. The molecular weight of the compound is 1812. How many Aluminium atoms are in the compound?

Leila and her friends want to rent a car for their one-day trip that is 100 kilometers long each way. The first option for a car rental costs $50 a day, excluding gasoline. The second option costs $115 a day including gasoline. A liter of gasoline can cover 15 kilometers and costs $0.90 per liter. Their car rental will need to carry them to and from their destination. How much will they save if they choose the first option rather than the second one?

A certain number of machines, working simultaneously and independently at an identical constant rate, can produce a total of x units of product p in 4 days. 106 of these machines, working simultaneously and independently at this constant rate, can produce a total of 3x units of product p in 6 days. How many machines were initially working?
The centerpieces at Glenda’s wedding reception include a fishbowl containing 2 fish, except for one table that has 3 fish. There are 26 tables. How many fish are there?
If 40 men do a work in a certain number of days, and 20 men can do the same work in 106 days, how many days does it take for the 40 men to complete the work?

A pharmaceutical company received $15.9 million in royalties on the first some amount in sales of the generic equivalent of one of its products and then $9 million in royalties on the next $108 million in sales. The ratio of royalties to sales decreased by approximately 72.22222222222221% from the first sales to the next $108 million in sales. What was the amount of the first sales?

There are 54 players in a chess group, and each player plays each of the others exactly once. Given that each game is played by two players, a total of 1431 games will be played. How many times does each player play against the others?
During summer break, some kids from Lawrence County go to camp, and the other 495,718 kids stay home. There are about 495,771 kids in Lawrence County. How many kids go to camp?
If the weight of 12 meters long rod is 106 kg, what is the weight of 6 meters long rod?

Milly needs to return a book she decided was really boring. The book weighs 10 pounds, cost $190, and needs to be returned to a distribution center 25 miles away. If the shipping company charges $0.35 per pound plus $0.08 per mile, and Amazon will only refund 75% of the book's purchase price, how much money will Milly lose?
The tank of John's car is full: it contains 120 liters of gasoline. After a journey of 200 km, there are 14 liters left. What is the fuel consumption of this car per 100 km?
Jimmy has a collection of 5 action figures, each worth $12. He decides to sell them all for $1.40 less than each figure's value. How much does he earn in total?
Paige used three of her pencils. Now she has some pencils left. She initially had 56 pencils. How many pencils does Paige have now?

A tank is filled by 3 pipes A, B, and C. Pipe A is twice as fast as pipe B, and B is twice as fast as C. If pipe B alone takes 185.5 hours to fill the tank, how much time will it take for all three pipes to fill the tank together?
Divide $265 among x and y in the ratio 2:8. How many dollars does x get?
Arthur baked 35 muffins. He should bake 18 more muffins to have a certain number of muffins. How many muffins will Arthur have after baking the additional muffins?
Aubrey lives 212 miles away from his school. His one way journey takes 4 hours. What is his average speed in miles per hour?

Katie and her sister combined the candy they received for Halloween. Katie had 15 pieces of candy while her sister had some pieces. They ate 15 pieces the first night and had 53 pieces left. How many pieces of candy did her sister have initially?
A museum had ninety-eight paintings. After they got rid of 45, they had some left. How many paintings did the museum have left?

Crazy Eddie has a key chain factory. Eddie managed to decrease the cost of manufacturing his key chains while keeping the same selling price, and thus increased the profit from the sale of each key chain from 47% of the selling price to 50% of the selling price. The manufacturing cost is now $50. What was the manufacturing cost before the decrease?

In a mixture of 643/9 litres, the ratio of milk to water is some ratio. An additional 11 litres of water is added to the mixture. The ratio of milk to water in the resulting mixture is 1.8. How many litres of milk are in the final mixture?
A number is tripled and then 41 is added. If the resultant is quadrupled, it becomes 800. What is that number?
Mildred weighs 19 pounds. Carol weighs 9 pounds more than Mildred. Jake weighs 3 pounds less than twice Carol’s weight. How much does Jake weigh?

Kaiden is collecting cans of soup for the local soup kitchen. He collects some cans during his first week and 200 during the second week. His goal is to collect 336 cans. He needs to collect 83 more cans of soup. How many cans did he collect during the first week?

Josh has $26 in his wallet, $50 invested in a business, and a debt of $30 to pay off. The business has three types of stocks: A, B, and C. Josh invested 40% in stock A, 30% in stock B, and 30% in stock C. Stock A's price rises by 20%, stock B's price rises by 30%, and stock C's price falls by 10%. If Josh sells all of his stocks after these changes, pays off his debt, and only then adds the remaining money back into his wallet, how much money will he have in his wallet?
Tracy, John and Jake found their combined weight to be 119 kilograms. If Tracy weighs 52 kg and Jake weighs 8 kg more than Tracy, what is the range of their weights?

Stephanie is checking her household budget, and needs to calculate how much she has left to pay for her bills. Her electricity bill costs $60, and this is paid in full. Her gas bill was $52, and she has already paid three-quarters of this. She makes another payment of $5 towards her gas bill while checking her budget. Her water bill is $50, which she has paid half of, and her internet bill is $40, which she has made 4 payments of $5 towards. Overall, how many dollars does Stephanie still need to pay to finish paying her bills?

Two pipes can fill a tank in 53 minutes and 106 minutes respectively. An outlet pipe can empty the tank in 106 minutes. If all three pipes are opened when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill the tank?

Charlie, an aspiring inventor, is planning to make two sets of wings to fulfill his dream to fly around the world. He needs 300 feathers for each set. His friend, Susan, offers to contribute some feathers as well. If Charlie already has 347 feathers and Susan is contributing 200 feathers, how many more feathers do they need to collect in total to create both sets of wings?
75 children were riding on the bus. At the bus stop, 22 children got off the bus. How many children were left on the bus?

Kate has to fill 52 balloons. For the first 10 minutes, she fills them at a rate of 200 gallons per minute. For the next 5 minutes, she fills them at half that rate. After that, she fills the rest at a rate of 2 gallons per minute. It takes her 143 minutes to fill all of the balloons. How many gallons of air does each balloon hold?
How many moles of Ammonium hydroxide are formed when 53 moles of Water react with 53 moles of Ammonium chloride to form 53 moles of Hydrochloric acid?

A certain clock marks every hour by striking a number of times equal to the hour, and the time required for a stroke is exactly 4 seconds, while the time between strokes is \( \frac{5}{11} \) seconds. At 1:00, the time lapse between the beginning of the first stroke and the end of the last stroke is 4 seconds. At 12:00, how many seconds elapse between the beginning of the first stroke and the end of the last stroke?
On dividing a number by 7, the quotient is 7 and the remainder is 4. What is the number being divided?
Kim plants 236 cherry pits. 25% of them sprout and Kim sells 6 of the saplings. How many cherry saplings does she have left?
9 is divided into two parts such that 7 times the first part added to 5 times the second part makes a certain number. The smaller part is 4. What is the number that is made?
If the perimeter of a rectangular garden is 186 m and its breadth is 40 m, what is the length of the garden?
The sum of ages of 5 children, each born a fixed number of years apart, is 970 years. The eldest child is 300 years old. What is the age difference between each child?
A cistern 5 m long and 7 m wide contains water up to a depth of 75 cm. What is the total area of the wet surface?

In the first half of a soccer match, team A scores 4 goals while team B scores 7 goals. In the second half, team B scores 4 times the number of goals it scored in the first half, and team A scores half of team B’s second-half total. What's the total number of goals scored in the match?

The novel that everyone is reading for English class has half as many pages as their history book. Their science book has half as many pages as their novel. If the history book has 212 pages, how many pages does their science book have?

Paul is collecting license plates from different states. He has plates from 40 different states, which is 80% of the 50 US states. His parents give him $4,240 total. How much do his parents give him for each percentage point?
If c is 21.2% of a and b is 40% of a, what percent of b is c?
If some number times a equals 53b and ab ≠ 0, the ratio of a to b is 1. What is the number that multiplies a?
The average marks of a class of 106 students is 40 and that of another class of 53 students is 70. The average marks of all the students is 50. How many students are in the second class?

A man can row 27 km/hr in still water. It takes him a certain ratio of time to row upstream as to row downstream. The rate of the current is 26 km/hr. What is the ratio of the time it takes him to row upstream to the time it takes him to row downstream?

Jack has a collection of classic literature in his mini library, and he has divided it into three sections: American literature, British literature, and world literature. In the American literature section, there are 2 classic authors, each with 10 books. In the British literature section, there are 3 classic authors, each with 7 books. Meanwhile, the world literature section consists of 4 classic authors, each with 3 books. Calculate the total number of books in Jack's classic literature collection.

Vinny weighed 300 pounds then lost 16 pounds in the first month of his diet. He continued his diet but each month, he lost half as much weight as he had lost in the previous month. At the start of the fifth month of his diet, he worked harder to lose extra weight then decided to end his diet. If Vinny weighed 217 pounds at the end of his diet, how many pounds did he lose throughout the fifth month?

In an examination, a student scores some marks for every correct answer and loses 1 mark for every wrong answer. He attempts all 60 questions and secures 102 marks. The number of questions he attempts correctly is 3. How many marks does he score for each correct answer?

A mother duck has 8 ducklings. The first 3 ducklings find 2 snails each. The next 3 ducklings find 3 snails each. The remaining ducklings each find 4 snails. The mother duck finds twice the total number of snails as the first two groups of ducklings combined. How many snails does the family have collectively?
James initially had 269 stickers. He received some more stickers for his birthday, and then he had a total of 322 stickers. How many stickers did James get for his birthday?

Kim loves to knit sweaters and can knit as many as 10 sweaters in a day if she gets the time. On a particular week, she knit 10 sweaters on Monday, 3 more sweaters on Tuesday than on Monday, 2 fewer sweaters on both Wednesday and Thursday than on Tuesday, and 8 sweaters on Friday. Calculate the total number of sweaters she knit that week.

John wants to lose weight. He eats a certain amount of calories a day and burns 1253 a day. If he needs to burn 4000 calories to lose 1 pound, it will take him 10 days to lose 3 pounds. How many calories does John eat a day?
A boy sells a book for Rs. 53 and gets a loss of 47%. To gain 10%, the selling price should be Rs. 110. What was the original selling price of the book?
There is sufficient food for 106 men for 16 days. After 15 days, 104 men leave the place. For how many days will the rest of the food last for the remaining men?
The length of a rectangular plot is 30 meters more than its breadth. The cost of fencing the plot at Rs. 25 per meter is Rs. 3800. What is the length of the plot in meters?

The multiplication of 2 numbers is 2597, and the quotient, when the larger one is divided by the smaller, is some value. The sum of the numbers is 378. What is the quotient when the larger number is divided by the smaller number?
Tom has some nickels and quarters. He has 53 more quarters than nickels, and the total value of all the coins is $29.15. How many nickels does he have?
Tom split 3 apples into 53 slices each. Tom gave 1/3 of the apple slices to his friend Jerry, then ate half of the remaining slices. How many apple slices does Tom have left?

The temperature of a certain cup of coffee immediately after it was poured was 100 degrees Fahrenheit. If the temperature F of the coffee T minutes after it was poured can be determined by the formula F = 94 * 2^(-0.1 T) + 6, where F is in degrees Fahrenheit, what was the temperature 10 minutes after it was poured?

Two dogsled teams raced across a 1460-mile course in Wyoming. Team A finished the course in 53 fewer hours than Team E. Team A's average speed was greater than Team E's, which was 20 mph. What was the difference in average speed between Team A and Team E?

Arnel had ten boxes of pencils with the same number of pencils in each box. He kept ten pencils and shared the remaining pencils equally with his five friends. His friends got 104 pencils each. How many pencils are in each box?
If the length of the longest chord of a certain circle is 106, what is the radius of that certain circle?
James rents his car out for $20 an hour for 2 hours, and then for $13 an hour for 1 hour, all in one day. How much does he make that day?

I bought two books for Rs. 166. I sold one at a certain loss percentage and the other at a gain of 19%, and then I found each book was sold at the same price. The cost of the book sold at a loss was Rs. 119. What was the loss percentage on the first book?

A normal lemon tree produces some lemons per year. Jim has specially engineered lemon trees that produce 50% more lemons per year. He has a grove that is 100 trees by 20 trees. He produces 795,000 lemons in 5 years. How many lemons does a normal lemon tree produce per year?
Rachel had to complete some pages of math homework and 50 pages of reading homework. She had 3 more pages of math homework than reading homework. How many pages of math homework did she have?
There are some boys and 12 girls in a class. The teacher needs to create groups with five members for their class activity. 13 groups are formed. How many boys are in the class?
Lana picked 45 tulips and 48 roses to make flower bouquets. If she only used 40 of the flowers though, how many extra flowers did Lana pick up?

On a 30-mile course, Pat bicycled at an average rate of 24 miles per hour for some minutes and without a break, ran the rest of the distance at an average rate of 6 miles per hour. Pat took 141 minutes to cover the entire course. How many minutes did Pat spend bicycling?
If a is a certain number and a^3 = 53 × 53 × 53 × 1, what is the value of a?

Two trains of different lengths run at the speed of 60 km/hr and 40 km/hr respectively in opposite directions on parallel tracks. The time which they take to cross each other is 7.308 seconds. If the other train is 150 m long, how long is the first train?
A certain high school has 103 students. Of these students, 40 are taking music, 20 are taking art, and 10 are taking both music and art. How many students are taking neither music nor art?

A team of 5 persons joins a shooting competition. The best marksman scored 10 points. If he had scored 17 points, the average score for the team would have been 12. The number of points the team scored was?

Sahil purchased a machine at Rs 15947, then got it repaired at some cost, then gave its transportation charges Rs 1000. Then he sold it with 50% profit. He actually sold it at Rs 25500. How much did he spend on the repair?
If some number ^ 8 = 53 ^ 8, and y = 8, what is the base number?

Rhonda, Sally, and Diane are members of their school's track team. The three of them run the 600-meter relay race together. Rhonda runs the first 200 meters of the race, Sally runs the second 200 meters of the race, and Diane runs the final 200 meters of the race. Rhonda can run 200 meters in 18 seconds. Sally takes two seconds longer to run the same distance, while Diane can run 200 meters three seconds faster than Rhonda. How many seconds does it take for the three of them to run the 600-meter relay race?
If (400) multiplied by some number equals (212)(100^1), what is the value of that number?
A sequence starts with 5, 17, 26, 41, and then a final number. What is the last number in the sequence if the sequence is 5, 17, 26, 41, 53?

At the Sterling Auto Store, they have 424 cars for sale. They have some sales professionals, and each salesperson sells 4 cars per month. It takes them 2 months to sell all of the cars. How many sales professionals do they have?

Two trains start from the same station, one is travelling at a speed of 60 mph and the other one at 7 mph along parallel tracks in the same direction. Find the distance between the two trains after 1 hour.
The speed of a car is 60 km in the first hour and 46 km in the second hour. What is the average speed of the car?
A can do a work in some days and B can do the same work in 2756 days. If they work together, they will complete the work in 52 days. In how many days can A complete the work alone?
A rectangle has a perimeter of 120 and a width of 7. What is its length?
A can do a work in 100 days and B in 200 days. If they work on it together for some days, then the fraction of the work that is left is 0.205. How many days did they work together?
Mrs. Taylor bought five smart televisions that cost $13.25 each. If the total sales price had a 20% discount, how much did Mrs. Taylor pay for the five televisions?

Jack received 4 emails in the morning, some emails in the afternoon, and 20 emails in the evening. Jack received 73 emails in the afternoon and evening. How many emails did Jack receive in the afternoon?

Alec noticed that the number of the page assigned for homework is divisible by some number and 13. The smallest possible page number that could have been assigned is 689. What is the other number that the page number is divisible by?
If Aang caught 50 fish, then Sokka caught 63 fish, and then Toph caught 46 fish, what is the average amount of fish that each person caught?

Haylee has 1 dozen guppies in her aquarium. Jose has half as many guppies as Haylee in his tank. Charliz has one-third of what Jose has in his tank. Nicolai has 4 times as many guppies as Charliz in his pond. Alice has 11 more guppies than Nicolai in her fishbowl, while Bob has half the guppies of Jose and Charliz combined in his aquarium. Cameron has 2^(Haylee's dozens of guppies) guppies in his fish tank. How many guppies do these seven friends have altogether?

In a school, 50% of the students are younger than 10, 1/20 are 10 years old, and 1/10 are older than 10 but younger than 12. The remaining 371 students are 12 years or older. How many students are 10 years old?

In a class of 75 students, 12 enrolled for both English and German. 22 enrolled for German. If the students of the class enrolled for at least one of the two subjects, how many students enrolled for only English and not German?

To have a more stable treehouse, Charlie's father decided to tie the corner posts of the house to the tree itself. He used 24 inches of rope for the first post, 18 inches on the second, 7 inches on the third and 4 inches on the fourth. How many inches of rope were used?
A railway train 530 m long is moving at the rate of 36 kmph. In what time will it pass a telegraph post on its way?

Kiran has 80 currency notes in all, some of which were of Rs. 100 denomination and the remaining of Rs. 50 denomination. The total amount of all these currency notes was Rs. 5350. How many Rs. 50 notes does she have?

The average of some numbers was calculated as 5. It was discovered later on that while calculating the average, one number namely 80 was wrongly read as 27. The correct average is 6. How many numbers were there in the set?
Find the value of m when 62519 is multiplied by a certain number, and the result is 3,313,507. What is that number?

Jack and Christina are standing 159 feet apart on a sloping surface with a 15-degree incline. Their dog, Lindy, is standing next to Christina. At the same time, they all begin moving toward each other. Jack walks in a straight line toward Christina at a constant speed of 7 feet per second, while Christina walks in a straight line towards Jack at a constant speed of 8 feet per second. Lindy runs at a constant speed of 5 feet per second from Christina to Jack, back to Christina, back to Jack, and so forth. The incline affects their pace as they need to adjust going uphill and downhill. The slope is consistent along the entire 159 feet distance. What is the total distance, in feet, that Lindy has traveled when the three meet at one place?

A man sitting in a train which is traveling at 55 kmph observes that a goods train, traveling in the opposite direction, takes 10 seconds to pass him. The goods train is 300 m long. What is the speed of the goods train in kmph?

Enrique earns a 15% commission on every piece of clothing item he sells. In one day he sells 2 $400.00 suits, some shirts that cost $20.00 each and 2 pairs of loafers that are $70.00 each. He earns $300 in commission. How many shirts did he sell?
In digging a pond with a certain length, 10 m wide, and 8 m deep, the volume of the soil extracted is 4240 cubic meters. What is the length of the pond?
The owner of a small store divided the sugar into 4 packs. Each pack weighs 12 grams and has 5 grams of sugar left. How many grams of sugar did he start with?
